<!doctype html>
<html lang="pt-BR">
<head>
<meta charset="utf-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1, minimum-scale=1, maximum-scale=1, user-scalable=no, viewport-fit=cover">
<title>Texas Hold’em</title>
<meta name="theme-color" content="#5A0FA6">
<meta name="mobile-web-app-capable" content="yes"><meta name="apple-mobile-web-app-capable" content="yes">
<meta name="apple-mobile-web-app-status-bar-style" content="black-translucent"><meta name="apple-mobile-web-app-title" content="Hold’em">
<link rel="manifest" href="manifest.webmanifest">
<link rel="icon" type="image/png" href="data:image/png;base64,">
<link rel="apple-touch-icon" href="data:image/png;base64,">
<link rel="stylesheet" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Baloo+2:wght@800&family=Fredoka:wght@400;500;600;700&display=swap">
<style>
:root{color-scheme:dark;--r9:#0E1013;--r8:#1A1D21;--r7:#23272C;--r6:#2E3338;--i1:#ECE8DF;--i3:#B3B0A8;--i5:#7C7F84;--felt:#1F4D3A;--felt2:#163A2B;--line:rgba(236,232,223,.1);--face:#F2EEE4;--back:#26364A;--fold:#6B7683;--call:#5E8F76;--raise:#C27A2C;--win:#D8CBA3;--c-s:#1B1D20;--c-c:#1B1D20;--c-h:#A32A2F;--c-d:#A32A2F;--sp:1;--e1:cubic-bezier(.22,.61,.36,1)}
*{box-sizing:border-box;margin:0}
html,body{height:100%}
body{background:var(--r9);color:var(--i1);font:400 14px/1.3 Inter,system-ui,-apple-system,'Segoe UI',sans-serif;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums;font-feature-settings:'tnum','cv11';padding:env(safe-area-inset-top) 0 env(safe-area-inset-bottom);overflow:hidden}
button{font:inherit;color:inherit;background:var(--r7);border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.08);border-radius:8px;padding:6px 10px;cursor:pointer}
button:active{filter:brightness(.9);transform:translateY(1px)}
button:focus-visible,input:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--i3);outline-offset:2px}
#app{height:100%;max-width:760px;margin:auto;display:flex;flex-direction:column}
header{display:flex;gap:6px;align-items:center;padding:8px 10px;overflow-x:auto;white-space:nowrap;scrollbar-width:none}
header svg{width:20px;height:20px;flex:none}
header .t{font-weight:600;margin-right:auto;padding-left:4px}
header button{font-size:12px;padding:5px 9px}
#tbl{flex:1;position:relative;margin:0 8px;border-radius:999px;background:radial-gradient(ellipse at 50% 40%,var(--felt),var(--felt2));border:6px solid #2A2522;box-shadow:inset 0 0 40px rgba(0,0,0,.35);display:flex;flex-direction:column;justify-content:flex-end;padding:10px 6px 22px;min-height:0;overflow:hidden}
#tbl:after{content:"";position:absolute;inset:0;opacity:.04;pointer-events:none;background-image:url("data:image/svg+xml;utf8,<svg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' width='160' height='160'><filter id='n'><feTurbulence type='fractalNoise' baseFrequency='.8' numOctaves='2'/></filter><rect width='100%' height='100%' filter='url(%23n)'/></svg>")}
#bots{position:absolute;inset:0;z-index:2;pointer-events:none}#bots .pod{position:absolute;pointer-events:auto}#bots .pod[data-pos=l]{left:10px;top:40%}#bots .pod[data-pos=t]{top:18px;left:0;right:0;margin:auto;width:max-content}#bots .pod[data-pos=r]{right:10px;top:40%}
#mid{position:absolute;left:0;right:0;top:22%;display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;gap:6px;z-index:1}
#potw{text-align:center}#potw small{display:block;color:var(--i3);font-size:11px}#pot{font-size:28px;font-weight:600;display:inline-block}#spots{color:var(--i3);font-size:12px;min-height:15px}
#board{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;justify-content:center;gap:6px;--cw:50px;width:calc(var(--cw)*3 + 12px);min-height:calc(var(--cw)*1.4)}
#board:empty:before{content:"";}
.slot{width:50px;aspect-ratio:2.5/3.5;border:1px dashed var(--line);border-radius:6%;background:rgba(0,0,0,.12);position:absolute}
#bw{position:relative;display:flex;gap:6px}
#msg{min-height:44px;text-align:center;font-size:13px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;gap:6px;max-width:190px}
#msg b{font-weight:600}
#deck{position:absolute;top:22%;left:calc(50% + 66px);width:30px;aspect-ratio:2.5/3.5;border-radius:5px;background:var(--back);box-shadow:1px 1px 0 #1b2838,2px 2px 0 #1b2838,0 4px 8px rgba(0,0,0,.4)}
#hero{display:flex;justify-content:center;z-index:1}
.pod{position:relative;background:var(--r8);border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.08);border-radius:14px;padding:6px 8px;min-width:96px;box-shadow:0 1px 0 rgba(0,0,0,.5),0 3px 6px rgba(0,0,0,.35);display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;gap:4px;transition:opacity .3s}
.pod.turn{border-color:var(--i3);animation:wob .9s ease-in-out infinite}.pod.fold{opacity:.5}
.pod .cards{display:flex;--cw:36px;min-height:calc(var(--cw)*1.4)}
.pod .cards .card+.card{margin-left:-8px}
.pod.hero .cards{--cw:72px}.pod.hero .cards .card+.card{margin-left:-4px}.pod.hero{flex-direction:column-reverse}
.inf{display:flex;gap:6px;align-items:center}
.av{width:26px;height:26px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--r6);display:grid;place-items:center;font-weight:600;font-size:12px}
.nm{font-weight:500;font-size:13px}.sk{font-size:13px;font-weight:600}.tg{font-size:10px;color:var(--i5)}
.ab{font-size:11px;min-height:16px;padding:1px 8px;border-radius:99px;background:rgba(255,255,255,.07);color:var(--i3)}
.ab:empty{visibility:hidden}.ab.f{color:var(--fold)}.ab.c{color:#8DBBA2;background:rgba(94,143,118,.18)}.ab.r{color:#E0A25E;background:rgba(194,122,44,.18)}
.bt{font-size:12px;min-height:16px;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:4px;color:var(--i1)}
.chip{width:14px;height:14px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--c);border:3px dashed rgba(239,234,224,.8);box-shadow:0 1px 2px rgba(0,0,0,.5)}
.dl{position:absolute;top:-8px;right:-6px;width:22px;height:22px;border-radius:50%;background:#E9E4D8;color:#3A3733;font-weight:600;font-size:12px;display:none;align-items:center;justify-content:center;box-shadow:0 1px 0 rgba(0,0,0,.5),0 2px 4px rgba(0,0,0,.4)}
#str{text-align:center;font-size:12px;color:var(--i3);min-height:16px}
.card{width:var(--cw);aspect-ratio:2.5/3.5;position:relative;perspective:600px;flex:none}
.card.new{animation:dl calc(.45s*var(--sp)) cubic-bezier(.3,.7,.4,1) both}
@keyframes dl{from{transform:translate(var(--fx),var(--fy)) rotate(-18deg) scale(.5);opacity:0}15%{opacity:1}65%{transform:translate(0,-6px) rotate(6deg) scale(1.15)}82%{transform:translate(0,2px) rotate(-3deg) scale(.95)}}
.in{position:absolute;inset:0;transform-style:preserve-3d;transition:transform calc(.5s*var(--sp)) cubic-bezier(.34,1.56,.64,1),filter .3s}
.card.up .in{transform:rotateY(180deg)}
.f,.b{position:absolute;inset:0;border-radius:6%;backface-visibility:hidden;box-shadow:0 1px 1px rgba(0,0,0,.45),0 4px 8px rgba(0,0,0,.28)}
.b{background:var(--back) repeating-linear-gradient(45deg,transparent 0 6px,rgba(255,255,255,.05) 6px 7px);border:1px solid #31455E}
.b svg{position:absolute;width:30%;left:35%;top:35%;color:#31455E}
.f{transform:rotateY(180deg);background:var(--face);color:var(--cs);font-weight:600}
.card[data-s=s]{--cs:var(--c-s)}.card[data-s=c]{--cs:var(--c-c)}.card[data-s=h]{--cs:var(--c-h)}.card[data-s=d]{--cs:var(--c-d)}
.f i{position:absolute;left:9%;top:3%;font-style:normal;font-size:calc(var(--cw)*.34);line-height:1}
.f u{position:absolute;left:9%;top:calc(var(--cw)*.36);text-decoration:none;font-size:calc(var(--cw)*.24);line-height:1}
.f b{position:absolute;right:10%;bottom:4%;font-size:calc(var(--cw)*.55);line-height:1}
.card.fold .in{filter:brightness(.55);transform:translateY(6px) rotate(-6deg)}.card.up.fold .in{transform:rotateY(180deg) translateY(6px) rotate(-6deg)}.card.dim .in{filter:brightness(.6)}
.card.win .in{transform:rotateY(180deg) translateY(-3px)}.card.win .f{box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 2px var(--win),0 4px 8px rgba(0,0,0,.3)}
.mini{--cw:34px}.mini .in{transition:none;transform:rotateY(180deg)}
#bar{padding:8px 10px 10px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:8px;opacity:.38;pointer-events:none;transition:opacity .18s}
#bar.on{opacity:1;pointer-events:auto}
#tip{font-size:12px;color:var(--i3);background:var(--r8);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:10px;padding:8px 10px}
#rz{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:8px}
.sc{display:flex;gap:6px}.sc button{flex:1;font-size:12px}
.sl{display:flex;gap:8px;align-items:center}.sl input{flex:1;accent-color:var(--raise);height:28px}
.ab2{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1.4fr 1.4fr;gap:8px}
.ab2 button{height:52px;font-weight:600;font-size:15px;border-radius:10px}
#fd{background:transparent;color:var(--fold);border-color:var(--fold)}#cc{background:var(--call);color:#101214}#rs{background:var(--raise);color:#101214}
#nx{background:var(--i1);color:#101214;font-weight:600;padding:8px 16px}
#md{position:fixed;inset:0;background:rgba(10,12,14,.8);display:none;align-items:center;justify-content:center;z-index:9;padding:12px}
#md.on{display:flex}#mdc{background:var(--r8);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:16px;max-width:560px;width:100%;max-height:92%;overflow:auto;padding:16px 18px}
#mdc h2{font-size:18px;font-weight:600;margin-bottom:8px}#mdc h3{font-size:14px;font-weight:600;margin:14px 0 6px}
#mdc ol{padding-left:18px;color:var(--i3);display:grid;gap:4px}#mdc ol b{color:var(--i1);font-weight:500}
.hr{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;padding:6px 0;border-top:1px solid var(--line)}.hr .cs{display:flex;gap:3px;flex:none}.hr span{font-size:12px;color:var(--i3)}.hr b{display:block;color:var(--i1);font-weight:500;font-size:13px}
.card.win{animation:hop .7s cubic-bezier(.3,.7,.4,1) 3}@keyframes hop{50%{transform:translateY(-14px) rotate(-4deg) scale(1.08)}}.pp{animation:pop .45s cubic-bezier(.34,1.56,.64,1)}@keyframes pop{from{transform:scale(.4)}}@keyframes wob{50%{transform:rotate(-1.5deg) translateY(-2px)}}
#mnu{position:fixed;inset:0;background:rgba(10,12,14,.7);display:none;justify-content:flex-end;z-index:8}#mnu.on{display:flex}
.mc{width:min(280px,82%);background:var(--r8);border-left:1px solid var(--line);padding:calc(16px + env(safe-area-inset-top)) 16px 16px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:8px;animation:pop .35s cubic-bezier(.34,1.56,.64,1)}.mc h2{font-size:18px;font-weight:600;margin-bottom:6px}.mc button{text-align:left;padding:12px 14px;font-size:14px;border-radius:14px}
#home{position:fixed;inset:0;z-index:7;background:radial-gradient(ellipse at 50% 30%,var(--felt),var(--r9) 78%);display:none;align-items:center;justify-content:center;padding:calc(20px + env(safe-area-inset-top)) 20px calc(20px + env(safe-area-inset-bottom));overflow:auto}#home.on{display:flex}
.pg{width:100%;max-width:380px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:14px;margin:auto}.pg[hidden]{display:none}
.pg .lg{width:76px;height:76px;margin:0 auto;border-radius:22px;background:var(--r9);display:grid;place-items:center;box-shadow:0 2px 0 rgba(0,0,0,.5),0 8px 16px rgba(0,0,0,.4);animation:pop .6s cubic-bezier(.34,1.56,.64,1)}.pg .lg svg{width:42px;height:42px}
.pg h1{text-align:center;font-size:30px;font-weight:600}.pg p{text-align:center;color:var(--i3)}.pg h2{font-size:20px;font-weight:600}
.pg button{padding:14px;border-radius:16px;font-size:15px;transition:transform .15s cubic-bezier(.34,1.56,.64,1)}.pg button:active{transform:scale(.96)}.pg .big{background:var(--raise);color:#101214;font-weight:600;font-size:17px}
.fld{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:6px}.fld>label{font-size:12px;color:var(--i3)}.fld input[type=range]{accent-color:var(--raise);height:28px}
.seg{display:flex;gap:6px}.seg button{flex:1;padding:10px 6px;font-size:13px;border-radius:12px}.seg button.on{background:var(--i1);color:#101214;font-weight:600}.seg button:disabled{opacity:.4}
.stk{display:flex}.stk .chip+.chip{margin-left:-9px}
.bt.sw{animation:sw calc(.3s*var(--sp)) var(--e1) both}
@keyframes sw{40%{transform:translate(0,-10px) scale(1.3)}to{transform:translate(var(--tx),var(--ty)) rotate(360deg) scale(.5);opacity:0}}
@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.card.new{animation-duration:.1s}.in{transition-duration:.1s}}
@media(max-width:420px){.pod{min-width:84px;padding:5px}.pod .cards{--cw:32px}#board{--cw:48px}.slot{width:48px}}
/* ===== Design system cartunesco ===== */
:root{color-scheme:dark;--felt:#22D18B;--felt2:#0E9F68;--ink:#1B0B3F;--grape:#4B0A92;--cream:#FBF7F2;--r9:#4B0A92;--r8:#FBF7F2;--r7:#FFFFFF;--r6:#EDE6FF;--i1:#FFFFFF;--i3:#FFE9A3;--i5:#8B7CC8;--line:rgba(255,255,255,.35);--face:#FBF7F2;--back:#E8182D;--fold:#8E9BFF;--call:#2EE59D;--raise:#FFD60A;--win:#FFD60A;--c-s:#2B2250;--c-c:#2B2250;--c-h:#FF3B5C;--c-d:#FF3B5C}
body{font-family:Fredoka,'Baloo 2','Trebuchet MS',system-ui,sans-serif;font-weight:500;font-variant-numeric:normal;font-feature-settings:normal;background:var(--grape);background-image:radial-gradient(circle at 15% 8%,#8A14DB 0,transparent 45%),radial-gradient(circle at 92% 95%,rgba(232,24,45,.35) 0,transparent 42%)}
button{font-family:inherit;font-weight:600;background:#fff;color:var(--ink);border:3px solid var(--ink);border-radius:14px;box-shadow:0 4px 0 var(--ink);transition:transform .12s cubic-bezier(.34,1.56,.64,1),box-shadow .12s}
button:active{filter:none;transform:translateY(3px) scale(.97);box-shadow:0 1px 0 var(--ink)}
button:disabled{opacity:.5}
header .t{font-size:20px;font-weight:700;color:#fff;text-shadow:0 3px 0 var(--ink),2px 0 var(--ink),-2px 0 var(--ink),0 -2px 0 var(--ink)}
header svg{color:#FFD60A;filter:drop-shadow(0 2px 0 var(--ink))}header button{font-size:13px;padding:5px 11px}
#tbl{border:7px solid #FFC21A;border-radius:999px;background:radial-gradient(circle,rgba(255,255,255,.14) 2px,transparent 2.6px) 0 0/24px 24px,radial-gradient(ellipse at 50% 40%,var(--felt),var(--felt2));box-shadow:0 0 0 4px var(--ink),0 8px 0 4px var(--ink),inset 0 0 0 3px rgba(30,17,71,.35),inset 0 0 40px rgba(0,0,0,.18)}
#tbl:after{display:none}
.pod{background:var(--cream);color:var(--ink);border:3px solid var(--ink);border-radius:20px;box-shadow:0 4px 0 var(--ink)}
.pod.turn{border-color:var(--ink);box-shadow:0 0 0 4px #FFD60A,0 4px 0 4px var(--ink)}
.pod.fold{opacity:.55}
.av{width:32px;height:32px;font-size:19px;border:2.5px solid var(--ink)}
.nm{font-weight:600;font-size:14px}.sk{font-size:14px;font-weight:700;color:#0B7A4E}.tg{color:#7A68C4;font-size:10px}
.ab{font-size:12px;font-weight:600;border:2px solid var(--ink);background:#EDE6FF;color:#4B3A9A;padding:0 9px}
.ab.f{background:#DDE1FF;color:#4651C9}.ab.c{background:#C5F7E0;color:#0B7A4E}.ab.r{background:#FFE3A0;color:#A05200}
.bt{color:#fff;font-weight:700;font-size:13px;text-shadow:0 2px 0 var(--ink)}
.pod .bt{color:var(--ink);text-shadow:none}
.chip{width:16px;height:16px;border:3px dashed rgba(255,255,255,.95);box-shadow:0 0 0 2px var(--ink),0 3px 0 2px var(--ink)}
.dl{background:#FFD60A;color:var(--ink);border:2.5px solid var(--ink);font-weight:700;box-shadow:0 2px 0 var(--ink)}
#potw small{color:#FFF3B0;font-weight:600;font-size:12px;letter-spacing:.06em;text-transform:uppercase;text-shadow:0 2px 0 var(--ink)}
#pot{font-size:32px;font-weight:700;color:#fff;text-shadow:0 3px 0 var(--ink),2px 0 var(--ink),-2px 0 var(--ink),0 -2px 0 var(--ink)}
#pot:before{content:'🪙 ';font-size:.8em}
#spots{color:#FFF3B0;text-shadow:0 2px 0 var(--ink)}
#msg{color:#fff;text-shadow:0 2px 0 var(--ink);font-weight:600}
#str{min-height:22px;margin-bottom:4px}#str:not(:empty){display:table;margin:0 auto 4px;background:#FFD60A;color:var(--ink);font-weight:600;font-size:13px;padding:2px 12px;border:2.5px solid var(--ink);border-radius:99px;box-shadow:0 3px 0 var(--ink)}
#deck{background:var(--back) radial-gradient(circle,rgba(255,255,255,.4) 1.5px,transparent 2px) 0 0/8px 8px;border:2.5px solid var(--ink);box-shadow:0 3px 0 var(--ink),2px 5px 0 var(--ink)}
.card{filter:drop-shadow(0 3px 0 var(--ink))}
.f,.b{border:2.5px solid var(--ink);border-radius:11%;box-shadow:none}
.f{font-weight:700}
.b{background:var(--back) radial-gradient(circle,rgba(255,255,255,.45) 1.6px,transparent 2.1px) 0 0/9px 9px}
.b svg{width:44%;left:28%;top:28%;color:#FFE066;filter:drop-shadow(0 2px 0 var(--ink))}
.card.fold .in{filter:brightness(.7) saturate(.6)}.card.dim .in{filter:brightness(.7) saturate(.7)}
.card.win .f{box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 3px var(--win);background:#FFF6C9}
#bar{opacity:.45}
.ab2 button{height:56px;font-size:17px;border-radius:16px}
#fd{background:var(--fold);color:var(--ink);border-color:var(--ink)}#cc{background:var(--call);color:var(--ink)}#rs{background:var(--raise);color:var(--ink)}
.sc button{font-size:13px;padding:6px}.sl input{accent-color:#E8182D}
#tip{background:#FFF3B0;color:#4B3A9A;border:3px solid var(--ink);border-radius:14px;font-weight:500}
#nx{background:#2EE59D;color:var(--ink);font-weight:700;padding:9px 18px;font-size:15px;animation:pop .5s cubic-bezier(.34,1.56,.64,1)}
#md,#mnu{background:rgba(30,17,71,.78)}
#mdc,.mc{background:var(--cream);color:var(--ink);border:4px solid var(--ink)}#mdc{border-radius:26px;box-shadow:0 6px 0 var(--ink)}
.mc{border-width:0 0 0 4px}.mc h2,#mdc h2,#mdc h3{color:var(--ink);font-weight:700}
#mdc ol{color:#4B3A9A}#mdc ol b{color:var(--ink);font-weight:600}
.hr{border-top:2px dashed #D4C8FF}.hr span{color:#4B3A9A}.hr b{color:var(--ink);font-weight:600}
#home{background:radial-gradient(circle at 50% 22%,#7B52F0 0,var(--grape) 72%)}
#home:after{content:'♠ ♥ ♦ ♣';position:absolute;bottom:5%;left:0;right:0;text-align:center;font-size:44px;letter-spacing:14px;color:rgba(255,255,255,.2);animation:bob 3s ease-in-out infinite;pointer-events:none}
@keyframes bob{50%{transform:translateY(-10px) rotate(-2deg)}}
.pg{position:relative;z-index:1}
.pg .lg{background:#FFD60A;border:4px solid var(--ink);box-shadow:0 6px 0 var(--ink);border-radius:28px;width:88px;height:88px;animation:pop .6s cubic-bezier(.34,1.56,.64,1),bob 3s ease-in-out .6s infinite}.pg .lg svg{color:#FF3B5C;filter:drop-shadow(0 2px 0 var(--ink))}
.pg h1{font-size:40px;font-weight:700;color:#fff;text-shadow:0 4px 0 var(--ink),3px 0 var(--ink),-3px 0 var(--ink),0 -3px 0 var(--ink)}
.pg h2{color:#fff;font-weight:700;text-shadow:0 3px 0 var(--ink)}.pg p{color:#FFE9A3;font-weight:500;font-size:16px}
.pg .big{background:#2EE59D;color:var(--ink);font-weight:700;font-size:20px;padding:16px}
.fld>label{color:#FFE9A3;font-weight:600;font-size:13px}
.seg button{font-size:14px}.seg button.on{background:#FFD60A;color:var(--ink);box-shadow:0 4px 0 var(--ink),inset 0 0 0 2px #fff7}

.pod.fold{opacity:1;filter:grayscale(.85) brightness(.85)}
#bots .pod[data-pos=l],#bots .pod[data-pos=r]{top:47%;max-width:100px;min-width:84px}#bots .pod[data-pos=l]{left:4px}#bots .pod[data-pos=r]{right:4px}
#bots .pod[data-pos=l] .inf,#bots .pod[data-pos=r] .inf{flex-direction:column;gap:2px;text-align:center}
.tg{white-space:normal;text-align:center;line-height:1.1}
#mid{top:30%}#deck{top:30%}
#msg:not(:empty){position:fixed;left:12px;right:12px;bottom:calc(12px + env(safe-area-inset-bottom));max-width:none;z-index:6;background:var(--cream);color:var(--ink);text-shadow:none;border:4px solid var(--ink);border-radius:22px;box-shadow:0 5px 0 var(--ink);padding:12px 14px;font-size:15px;line-height:1.35;animation:pop .45s cubic-bezier(.34,1.56,.64,1)}
#msg b{color:#C2185B;font-weight:700}
/* v2: sem quadrados, verso limpo, board em 1 linha */
.pod{background:none;border:0;box-shadow:none;padding:0;min-width:0;gap:3px}
.pod.turn{box-shadow:none}.pod.turn .inf{box-shadow:0 0 0 4px #FFD60A,0 4px 0 4px var(--ink)}
.pod.fold{filter:grayscale(.9) brightness(.8)}
.inf{background:var(--cream);color:var(--ink);border:3px solid var(--ink);border-radius:99px;padding:3px 10px 3px 4px;box-shadow:0 3px 0 var(--ink)}
#bots .pod[data-pos=l] .inf,#bots .pod[data-pos=r] .inf{flex-direction:column;border-radius:16px;padding:4px 8px}
#bots .pod[data-pos=l],#bots .pod[data-pos=r]{min-width:0;max-width:96px}
.pod .bt{color:#fff;text-shadow:0 2px 0 var(--ink)}
.dl{top:-10px;right:-8px}
.b{background:var(--back);box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 3px #fff}
.b svg{display:none}
#deck{background:var(--back);box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 2px #fff,0 3px 0 var(--ink),2px 5px 0 var(--ink)}
#board{flex-wrap:nowrap;width:auto;--cw:48px;gap:5px}
.pod.hero .cards{--cw:64px}
#mid{top:26%}#deck{top:26%}
#bots .pod[data-pos=l],#bots .pod[data-pos=r]{top:56%}
#board{--cw:44px;gap:4px}
.tg{display:none}
.inf{padding:2px 9px 2px 3px;gap:5px;border-width:2.5px;box-shadow:0 2px 0 var(--ink)}
.av{width:26px;height:26px;font-size:16px}
.nm{font-size:12px;line-height:1.1}.sk{font-size:12px;line-height:1.1}
#bots .pod[data-pos=l] .inf,#bots .pod[data-pos=r] .inf{padding:3px 8px;gap:1px;border-radius:14px}
#bots .pod[data-pos=l],#bots .pod[data-pos=r]{max-width:80px}
/* v3: aposta estilo apps reais */
.sc button{display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;justify-content:center;line-height:1.15;padding:4px 2px;font-size:12px;min-height:44px}
.sc button small{font-size:11px;font-weight:700;color:#7A68C4}
.sc button.sel{background:#FFD60A}.sc button.sel small{color:var(--ink)}
.am{display:flex;gap:8px;align-items:center}.am button{width:52px;height:48px;font-size:24px;padding:0;flex:none}
#ra{flex:1;min-width:0;height:48px;text-align:center;font:700 24px Fredoka,system-ui,sans-serif;color:var(--ink);background:#fff;border:3px solid var(--ink);border-radius:14px;box-shadow:inset 0 3px 0 rgba(30,17,71,.12)}
#ra:focus-visible{outline:3px solid #FFD60A;outline-offset:1px}
.sl input{width:100%}
.ab2{grid-template-columns:1fr 1.15fr 1.7fr}.ab2 button{font-size:15px;padding:4px}
#app.rzo #tip{display:none}
#app.rzo #bots .pod[data-pos=l],#app.rzo #bots .pod[data-pos=r]{top:50%}
#app.rzo #bots .pod[data-pos=l]{left:16px}#app.rzo #bots .pod[data-pos=r]{right:16px}
/* v4: mesa de verdade, sem moldura que corta */
#tbl{background:none;border:0;box-shadow:none;border-radius:0;overflow:visible;margin:24px 20px 16px;padding:10px 6px 24px}
#tbl:before{content:"";position:absolute;inset:0;z-index:0;border-radius:999px;border:9px solid #FFC21A;background:radial-gradient(circle,rgba(255,255,255,.14) 2px,transparent 2.6px) 0 0/24px 24px,radial-gradient(ellipse at 50% 45%,var(--felt),var(--felt2));box-shadow:0 0 0 4px var(--ink),0 8px 0 4px var(--ink),inset 0 0 0 3px rgba(30,17,71,.35),inset 0 0 40px rgba(0,0,0,.18)}
#tbl>div:last-child{position:relative;z-index:3}
#bots{z-index:3}
#bots .pod[data-pos=t]{top:-16px}
#bots .pod[data-pos=l],#bots .pod[data-pos=r],#app.rzo #bots .pod[data-pos=l],#app.rzo #bots .pod[data-pos=r]{top:50%}
#bots .pod[data-pos=l],#app.rzo #bots .pod[data-pos=l]{left:-16px}#bots .pod[data-pos=r],#app.rzo #bots .pod[data-pos=r]{right:-16px}
.pod:not(.hero) .cards{margin-bottom:-12px;position:relative;z-index:0}
.pod:not(.hero) .inf{position:relative;z-index:1}
.pod:not(.hero) .bt{position:absolute;white-space:nowrap}
#bots .pod[data-pos=t] .bt{left:calc(100% + 8px);top:55%}
#bots .pod[data-pos=l] .bt{left:calc(100% + 4px);top:62%}
#bots .pod[data-pos=r] .bt{right:calc(100% + 4px);top:62%}
#mid{top:27%}#deck{top:27%}
#str,#str:not(:empty){display:none}
/* v5: controles de aposta sempre visíveis (estilo apps BR) */
#rz{display:flex;flex-direction:row;gap:8px;align-items:center}#rz[hidden]{display:none}
#rz #mn,#rz #pl{width:44px;height:44px;flex:none;padding:0;font-size:22px}
#rz #rg{flex:1;min-width:0;width:auto}
.am{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:6px;width:122px;height:44px;flex:none;background:#fff;color:var(--ink);border:3px solid var(--ink);border-radius:99px;padding:0 12px;box-shadow:0 3px 0 var(--ink)}
.am span{font-weight:700;color:#7A68C4;font-size:13px}
.am #ra{flex:1;min-width:0;width:100%;height:auto;border:0;border-radius:0;background:none;box-shadow:none;padding:0;text-align:right;font:700 18px Fredoka,system-ui,sans-serif}
.ab2 button{display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;justify-content:center;line-height:1.1;height:60px;font-size:17px}
.ab2 button small{font-size:13px;font-weight:600}
#rs.allin{background:#FF7A45}
/* v6: slots do board, mão ao lado do nome, pilha de fichas */
#bw{position:relative;display:block}
#board,#slots{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(6,calc(var(--cw)/2 + 3px));grid-auto-rows:calc(var(--cw)*1.4 + 4px);gap:0;--cw:50px}
#board{width:auto;min-height:calc((var(--cw)*1.4 + 4px)*2)}
#slots{position:absolute;inset:0;pointer-events:none}
#board .card,#slots i{justify-self:center;align-self:center}
#slots i{width:var(--cw);aspect-ratio:2.5/3.5;border:2px dashed rgba(255,255,255,.55);border-radius:11%;background:rgba(0,0,0,.14);display:grid;place-items:end center;padding-bottom:5px;font:600 9px/1 Fredoka,system-ui,sans-serif;letter-spacing:.08em;color:rgba(255,255,255,.8);font-style:normal}
#board .card:nth-child(1),#slots i:nth-child(1){grid-area:1/1/2/3}#board .card:nth-child(2),#slots i:nth-child(2){grid-area:1/3/2/5}#board .card:nth-child(3),#slots i:nth-child(3){grid-area:1/5/2/7}
#board .card:nth-child(4),#slots i:nth-child(4){grid-area:2/2/3/4}#board .card:nth-child(5),#slots i:nth-child(5){grid-area:2/4/3/6}
#mid{top:21%;gap:4px}#deck{top:21%}
#pot:before{content:none}#pot{font-size:28px}
#pile{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;justify-content:center;width:64px;margin:0 auto 12px}#pile:empty{display:none}
#pile .chip{width:22px;height:22px;margin:-7px -2px 0;border-width:3.5px}
.chip.fly{position:fixed;z-index:30;pointer-events:none;margin:0}
.pod.hero{flex-direction:row;align-items:center;gap:10px}
.pod.hero .cards{--cw:68px}
.pod.hero .ab{position:absolute;right:0;top:-25px}
.pod.hero .bt{position:absolute;bottom:calc(100% + 26px);left:0;right:0;margin:0 auto;width:max-content}
/* v7: fichas empilhadas no pote */
#pile{display:flex;flex-wrap:nowrap;align-items:flex-end;justify-content:center;gap:6px;height:60px;width:auto;margin:0 auto 4px}
#pile:empty{display:flex}
.pcol{display:flex;flex-direction:column-reverse;align-items:center}
.pc{width:32px;height:18px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--c);box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 2.5px rgba(255,255,255,.75),0 3px 0 var(--ink),0 0 0 2px var(--ink);margin-top:-12px;font:700 9px/18px Fredoka,system-ui,sans-serif;color:#fff;text-align:center;text-shadow:0 1px 0 var(--ink)}
.pc.lt{color:var(--ink);text-shadow:none}
.pc.drop{animation:cdrop .42s cubic-bezier(.34,1.56,.64,1) var(--dl,0ms) both}
@keyframes cdrop{from{transform:translateY(-38px) scale(1.25);opacity:0}30%{opacity:1}}
/* v8: tamanhos como no app de referência */
#board,#slots{--cw:40px}#slots i{font-size:8px}
.pod.hero .cards{--cw:46px}.pod .cards{--cw:26px}.pod.hero .cards{--cw:46px}
#mid{top:50%;transform:translateY(-50%);gap:6px}#deck{top:34%;left:calc(50% + 84px)}
#potw{display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center}
#pot{font-size:20px;font-weight:700}#pot:before{content:'POTE: '}
#spots{min-height:14px;font-size:11px}
#pw2{height:60px;display:flex;align-items:flex-end}
#msg:empty{display:none}
.av{position:relative;width:42px;height:42px;font-size:25px;border-width:3px}
.pod.hero .av{width:48px;height:48px;font-size:28px}
.inf{gap:8px;padding:3px 16px 3px 4px}
.nm{font-size:14px}.sk{font-size:17px}.pod.hero .nm{font-size:15px}.pod.hero .sk{font-size:19px}
#bots .pod[data-pos=l] .inf,#bots .pod[data-pos=r] .inf{padding:4px 8px 5px;gap:2px}
#bots .pod[data-pos=l],#bots .pod[data-pos=r]{max-width:96px}
.ab{font-size:13px;padding:1px 10px}
.pb,.dl{position:absolute;bottom:-9px;width:27px;height:27px;border-radius:50%;place-items:center;font:700 12px/1 Fredoka,system-ui,sans-serif;border:2.5px solid var(--ink);box-shadow:0 2px 0 var(--ink);font-style:normal;top:auto;right:auto}
.pb{left:-12px;display:grid;background:#fff;color:#4B3A9A}.pb:empty{display:none}.pb.bb{background:#FFD60A;color:var(--ink)}.pb.sb{background:#8E9BFF;color:var(--ink)}
.dl{right:-12px;background:#FFD60A;color:var(--ink)}
.pod.hero .pb,.pod.hero .dl{bottom:-8px}
/* v9: ficha com borda listrada e miolo; sem info extra */
#spots{display:none}
#pw2{height:78px;margin-top:10px}
.pc{position:relative;width:36px;height:36px;margin-top:-31px;border-radius:50%;background:repeating-conic-gradient(#fff 0 15deg,var(--c) 15deg 30deg);box-shadow:0 0 0 2px var(--ink),0 4px 0 color-mix(in srgb,var(--c) 55%,#000),0 4px 0 2px var(--ink);font:0/0 sans-serif;text-shadow:none}
.pc:first-child{margin-top:0}
.pc:after{content:attr(data-v);position:absolute;inset:6px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--c);box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 2px rgba(255,255,255,.9);display:grid;place-items:center;font:700 11px/1 Fredoka,system-ui,sans-serif;color:#fff;text-shadow:0 1px 0 var(--ink)}
.pc.lt:after{color:var(--ink);text-shadow:none}
.chip{position:relative;border:0;background:repeating-conic-gradient(#fff 0 20deg,var(--c) 20deg 40deg);box-shadow:0 0 0 2px var(--ink),0 2px 0 2px var(--ink)}
.chip:after{content:'';position:absolute;inset:3.5px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--c);box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 1.5px rgba(255,255,255,.85)}
/* v10: fichas menores e perfil igual em todas as posições */
.pc{width:24px;height:24px;margin-top:-20px;box-shadow:0 0 0 1.5px var(--ink),0 3px 0 color-mix(in srgb,var(--c) 55%,#000),0 3px 0 1.5px var(--ink)}
.pc:first-child{margin-top:0}
.pc:after{inset:4.5px;font-size:8px;box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 1.5px rgba(255,255,255,.9)}
#pile{gap:4px;height:56px}#pw2{height:58px;margin-top:8px}
#bots .pod[data-pos=l] .inf,#bots .pod[data-pos=r] .inf,#app.rzo #bots .pod[data-pos=l] .inf{flex-direction:row;align-items:center;gap:8px;padding:3px 16px 3px 4px;border-radius:99px;text-align:left}
#bots .pod[data-pos=l],#bots .pod[data-pos=r]{max-width:none}
.pod.hero .av{width:42px;height:42px;font-size:25px}
.pod.hero .nm{font-size:14px}.pod.hero .sk{font-size:17px}
/* v11: texto do pote limpo */
#pot{font:600 20px/1.2 Fredoka,system-ui,sans-serif;letter-spacing:.02em;color:#fff;text-shadow:0 2px 0 rgba(30,17,71,.5)}
#pot:before{content:'POTE: ';font:inherit;letter-spacing:inherit}
/* v12: visual do ícone Texas Hold’em */
body{background-image:radial-gradient(circle at 50% 0,#8A14DB 0,transparent 55%),radial-gradient(circle at 92% 100%,rgba(232,24,45,.3) 0,transparent 42%)}
.sr{position:absolute;width:1px;height:1px;overflow:hidden;clip:rect(0 0 0 0);white-space:nowrap}
header .hi{width:34px;height:34px;border-radius:9px;border:2.5px solid var(--ink);box-shadow:0 2px 0 var(--ink);margin-left:2px}
header .t{font-family:'Baloo 2','Fredoka',system-ui,sans-serif;font-weight:800;font-size:23px;line-height:1;letter-spacing:.01em;color:#fff;text-shadow:none;-webkit-text-stroke:4px var(--ink);paint-order:stroke fill;white-space:nowrap}
header .t b,header .t i{font:inherit;font-style:normal}header .t i{color:#FFD60A}
.pg h2{font-family:'Baloo 2','Fredoka',system-ui,sans-serif;font-weight:800;-webkit-text-stroke:3px var(--ink);paint-order:stroke fill;text-shadow:none}
#home{background:radial-gradient(circle at 50% 34%,#8A14DB 0,#5A0FA6 50%,#3F0780 100%)}
.logo{display:block;width:min(88vw,380px);margin:0 auto -8px;-webkit-mask-image:radial-gradient(closest-side,#000 90%,transparent 100%);mask-image:radial-gradient(closest-side,#000 90%,transparent 100%);animation:pop .6s cubic-bezier(.34,1.56,.64,1)}
#home:after{color:rgba(255,255,255,.14)}
.pg .big{background:#FFD60A}
#rs.allin{background:#E8182D;color:#fff}
.sc button.sel,.seg button.on{background:#FFD60A}
/* v13: sem ícone/título no cabeçalho e sem naipes na home */
header{justify-content:flex-end}
#home:after{content:none;display:none}
/* v14: sem zoom + pré-ações (Correr / Cobrir) */
html{touch-action:pan-x pan-y;-webkit-text-size-adjust:100%;text-size-adjust:100%}
input[type=range]{touch-action:none}
#bar{opacity:1;pointer-events:auto;visibility:hidden;min-height:130px;justify-content:flex-end}
#bar.on,#bar.wt{visibility:visible}
#pre{display:none;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:8px}
#bar.wt #pre{display:grid}#bar.wt #rz,#bar.wt .ab2,#bar.wt #tip{display:none}
#pre button{height:60px;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:10px;font-size:17px;line-height:1.1;padding:4px 8px;border-radius:16px;text-align:left}
#pre button:before{content:'';width:22px;height:22px;flex:none;border-radius:50%;border:3px solid var(--rc);background:#fff;box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 3px #fff}
#pre button.sel{background:#FFD60A}
#pre button.sel:before{background:var(--rc)}
#pre button span{display:flex;flex-direction:column}
#pre button small{font-size:13px;font-weight:600}
#pf{--rc:#E8182D}#pk{--rc:#2F8CFF}
#mid.mg{z-index:5}
#slots i.fp{grid-area:1/1/2/7;width:calc(100% + 12px);aspect-ratio:auto;height:calc(var(--cw)*1.4 + 6px);font-size:10px;padding-bottom:4px}
#slots i.tn{grid-area:2/2/3/4}#slots i.rv{grid-area:2/4/3/6}
#rv{display:none;grid-column:3;background:#8E9BFF;color:var(--ink)}
#rv.sel{background:#FFD60A}
#bar.fo{visibility:visible}
#bar.fo #rz,#bar.fo #tip,#bar.fo #pre,#bar.fo #fd,#bar.fo #cc,#bar.fo #rs{display:none}
#bar.fo #rv{display:flex}
/* v15: menu profissional (home, salas, opções) */
#home{padding:calc(14px + env(safe-area-inset-top)) 18px calc(14px + env(safe-area-inset-bottom))}
#home:before{content:'';position:absolute;inset:0;pointer-events:none;background:radial-gradient(circle,rgba(255,255,255,.08) 2px,transparent 2.6px) 0 0/28px 28px}
.pg{max-width:420px}
#pgH,#pgL,#pgO{align-self:stretch;margin:0 auto;gap:0}
.tb{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between}
.pf{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;background:var(--cream);color:var(--ink);border:3px solid var(--ink);border-radius:99px;padding:3px 16px 3px 3px;box-shadow:0 3px 0 var(--ink);font-weight:700;font-size:15px}
.pf .pa{width:34px;height:34px;border-radius:50%;background:#FFD60A;border:2.5px solid var(--ink);display:grid;place-items:center;font-size:19px}
.ib{display:flex;gap:10px}
.pg .ic,.ic{width:46px;height:46px;padding:0;border-radius:50%;display:grid;place-items:center;flex:none}
.ic svg{width:24px;height:24px;fill:none;stroke:currentColor;stroke-width:2.6;stroke-linecap:round;stroke-linejoin:round}
.pg .ic.q{font:800 25px/1 'Baloo 2',Fredoka,sans-serif;padding:0}
#pgH .mid{margin:auto 0;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:16px;padding-bottom:3vh}
#pgH .logo{width:min(78vw,320px);margin:0 auto -2px}
.pg .mode{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:14px;width:100%;min-height:90px;padding:12px 14px 12px 12px;border-width:4px;border-radius:26px;text-align:left;position:relative;box-shadow:0 6px 0 var(--ink)}
.pg .mode:active{transform:translateY(4px);box-shadow:0 2px 0 var(--ink)}
.mode .mi{width:62px;height:62px;border-radius:18px;border:3px solid var(--ink);display:grid;place-items:center;flex:none;box-shadow:inset 0 -5px 0 rgba(30,17,71,.14)}
.mode .mi svg{width:34px;height:34px;fill:none;stroke:currentColor;stroke-width:2.3;stroke-linecap:round;stroke-linejoin:round}
.mode .mt{display:flex;flex-direction:column;flex:1;min-width:0}
.mode .mt b{font:800 25px/1 'Baloo 2',Fredoka,sans-serif}
.mode .mt small{font-size:14px;font-weight:500;margin-top:5px}
.mode .ch{width:26px;height:26px;fill:none;stroke:var(--ink);stroke-width:3.2;stroke-linecap:round;stroke-linejoin:round;flex:none}
.pg .mode.go{background:#FFD60A;color:var(--ink)}
.mode.go .mi{background:#fff;color:var(--ink)}
.pg .mode.off{background:#5A22B0;color:#fff}
.mode.off .mi{background:#7C4BD0;color:#D9C8FF}
.mode.off .mt small{color:#D9C8FF}
.bd{position:absolute;top:-13px;right:16px;background:#FF8A3D;color:var(--ink);font:700 12px/1 Fredoka,system-ui,sans-serif;letter-spacing:.05em;text-transform:uppercase;padding:6px 11px;border:2.5px solid var(--ink);border-radius:99px;box-shadow:0 2px 0 var(--ink);font-style:normal}
.pg p.ver{color:rgba(255,255,255,.55);font-size:12px;font-weight:500;padding-top:4px}
.ph{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:12px;padding:2px 0 16px}
.pg .ph h2{margin:0;font-size:31px;line-height:1.1}
.lst{flex:1;min-height:0;overflow:auto;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:16px;padding:2px 2px 18px;-webkit-overflow-scrolling:touch}
.pg .tbc{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:14px;width:100%;padding:12px 12px 12px 10px;border-radius:24px;background:var(--cream);color:var(--ink);text-align:left;border-width:3px;box-shadow:0 5px 0 var(--ink);flex:none}
.pg .tbc:active{transform:translateY(3px);box-shadow:0 2px 0 var(--ink)}
.tbc .tp{width:54px;height:76px;flex:none}
.tbc .ti{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:6px;flex:1;min-width:0}
.tbc .ti b{font:800 23px/1 'Baloo 2',Fredoka,sans-serif}
.tbc .ti small{font-size:13px;font-weight:600;color:#5B49A8}
.tbc .bs{display:flex;padding-left:2px}
.tbc .bs i{width:27px;height:27px;border-radius:50%;border:2.5px solid var(--ink);display:grid;place-items:center;font-size:14px;font-style:normal;margin-right:-7px}
.tbc .jg{background:#2EE59D;border:3px solid var(--ink);border-radius:14px;box-shadow:0 3px 0 var(--ink);padding:10px 14px;font:700 15px Fredoka,system-ui,sans-serif}
.grp{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:7px;flex:none}
.grp h4{font:700 13px Fredoka,system-ui,sans-serif;letter-spacing:.09em;text-transform:uppercase;color:#FFE9A3;padding-left:8px;text-shadow:0 2px 0 var(--ink)}
.grp .gc{background:var(--cream);color:var(--ink);border:3px solid var(--ink);border-radius:22px;box-shadow:0 5px 0 var(--ink);overflow:hidden}
.row{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:12px;padding:10px 14px;min-height:62px}
.row+.row{border-top:2px dashed #D4C8FF}
.row>label{font-weight:600;font-size:16px}
.row .seg{flex:none}
.pg .row .seg button{flex:none;padding:8px 12px;font-size:14px;border-width:2.5px;border-radius:12px;box-shadow:0 3px 0 var(--ink)}
.row input[type=range]{flex:1;min-width:0;max-width:190px;accent-color:#E8182D;height:28px}
.pg .seg.sw{gap:12px}
.pg .seg.sw button{width:42px;height:42px;padding:0;border-radius:50%;background:var(--g);font-size:0}
.pg .seg.sw button.on{background:var(--g);box-shadow:0 0 0 3px #FFD60A,0 0 0 6px var(--ink)}
#sheet{position:fixed;inset:0;z-index:30;display:flex;align-items:flex-end;justify-content:center;background:rgba(30,17,71,.72)}
#sheet[hidden]{display:none}
.shp{width:100%;max-width:460px;background:var(--cream);color:var(--ink);border:4px solid var(--ink);border-bottom:0;border-radius:28px 28px 0 0;padding:16px 18px calc(18px + env(safe-area-inset-bottom));display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:14px;animation:up .32s cubic-bezier(.34,1.3,.64,1)}
@keyframes up{from{transform:translateY(100%)}}
.shh{display:flex;align-items:flex-start;justify-content:space-between;gap:10px}
.shh h3{font:800 27px/1 'Baloo 2',Fredoka,sans-serif;margin:0;color:var(--ink)}
.shh p{color:#5B49A8;font-weight:600;font-size:14px;margin-top:5px}
.shp .fld>label{color:#4B3A9A}
.shp .big{background:#FFD60A;color:var(--ink);font-weight:700;font-size:20px;padding:16px;border-radius:18px;margin-top:2px}
#toast{position:fixed;left:50%;bottom:calc(30px + env(safe-area-inset-bottom));transform:translate(-50%,24px);opacity:0;pointer-events:none;z-index:40;background:var(--cream);color:var(--ink);border:3px solid var(--ink);border-radius:18px;box-shadow:0 4px 0 var(--ink);padding:11px 18px;font-weight:600;font-size:15px;width:max-content;max-width:min(92vw,360px);text-align:center;transition:opacity .2s,transform .3s cubic-bezier(.34,1.56,.64,1)}
#toast.on{opacity:1;transform:translate(-50%,0)}
.shake{animation:shk .4s}
@keyframes shk{20%{transform:translateX(-6px)}40%{transform:translateX(6px)}60%{transform:translateX(-4px)}80%{transform:translateX(3px)}}
/* mesa de 6: assentos extras */
#bots .pod[data-row=u]{top:15%}
.pod.gone{opacity:.6;filter:grayscale(1)}
.pod.gone .av{background:#B9B3CF}
.pod.gone .av svg{width:70%;height:70%;fill:#fff;stroke:none}
.pod.gone .nm{color:#7C7599;font-weight:600}
#bots .pod[data-pos][data-row=d]{top:49%}
#app.six #deck{top:13%;left:calc(50% - 15px)}
/* ===== online ===== */
#sheetM{position:fixed;inset:0;z-index:30;display:flex;align-items:flex-end;justify-content:center;background:rgba(30,17,71,.72)}
#sheetM[hidden]{display:none}
#tmr{font:700 14px Fredoka,system-ui,sans-serif;color:#FFD60A;margin-right:auto;padding-left:6px;text-shadow:0 2px 0 var(--ink)}
.mpin{width:100%;padding:13px 15px;border-radius:16px;border:3px solid var(--ink);background:#fff;color:var(--ink);font:600 17px Fredoka,system-ui,sans-serif;outline:none;min-width:0}
.mpin:focus{box-shadow:0 0 0 3px #FFD60A}
.pg .mpb{background:var(--cream);color:var(--ink);border:3px solid var(--ink);border-radius:16px;box-shadow:0 4px 0 var(--ink);font:700 16px Fredoka,system-ui,sans-serif;padding:12px 16px;flex:none}
.pg .mpb:active{transform:translateY(3px);box-shadow:0 1px 0 var(--ink)}
.pg .mpb.y{background:#FFD60A}.pg .mpb.g{background:#2EE59D}
.pg .mpb[disabled]{opacity:.55}
.mpc{padding:14px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:10px}
.mpn{color:#FFE9A3;font-weight:600;font-size:14px;text-align:center;min-height:18px}
.emo{display:flex;gap:6px;flex-wrap:wrap}
.pg .emo button{width:44px;height:44px;padding:0;font-size:22px;border-radius:14px;border:3px solid transparent;background:#EFE8FF}
.pg .emo button.on{border-color:var(--ink);background:#FFD60A}
.wal{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:12px;padding:12px 14px}
.wal .em{font-size:32px}.wal .nm{font:800 20px/1 'Baloo 2',Fredoka,sans-serif}.wal .co{font-weight:700;margin-top:3px;color:#5B49A8}
.wal>div{flex:1;min-width:0}
.mps{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:12px;padding:9px 14px;min-height:56px}
.mps+.mps{border-top:2px solid #E4DBF7}
.mps .av2{width:38px;height:38px;border-radius:50%;border:3px solid var(--ink);display:grid;place-items:center;font-size:19px;flex:none}
.mps b{font:700 17px Fredoka,system-ui,sans-serif;flex:1;min-width:0;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis;white-space:nowrap}
.mps small{font-weight:700;color:#5B49A8}.mps.free{color:#8C80B8}
#wCode{font:800 46px/1 'Baloo 2',Fredoka,sans-serif;letter-spacing:.14em;text-align:center;padding-top:4px}
.mpq{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:6px;font-weight:600;color:#5B49A8;font-size:14px;text-align:center;padding:0 12px 12px}
#msg small{opacity:.8;font-weight:600}
.avbig{width:120px;height:120px;border-radius:50%;border:4px solid var(--ink);display:grid;place-items:center;font-size:60px;box-shadow:0 4px 0 var(--ink);background-size:cover}
.pg .emo button.cs{width:38px;height:38px;border-radius:50%;border:3px solid var(--ink);padding:0}
.pg .emo button.cs.on{box-shadow:0 0 0 3px #fff,0 0 0 6px var(--ink)}
.wal .em{width:54px;height:54px;border-radius:50%;border:3px solid var(--ink);display:grid;place-items:center;font-size:28px;flex:none}
.mps.me{background:#FFF3C4}
</style>
</head>
<body>
<div id="app">
<header>
<span id="tmr"></span>
<button id="bMn" aria-label="Menu">☰ Menu</button>
</header>
<div id="tbl">
<div id="bots"></div>
<div id="deck"></div>
<div id="mid">
<div id="potw"><span id="pot">0</span><div id="spots"></div></div>
<div id="bw"><div id="slots"><i class="fp">FLOP</i><i class="tn">TURN</i><i class="rv">RIVER</i></div><div id="board"></div></div>
<div id="pw2"><div id="pile"></div></div>
<div id="msg"></div>
</div>
<div><div id="str"></div><div id="hero"></div></div>
</div>
<div id="bar">
<div id="rz"><button id="mn" aria-label="Diminuir">−</button><input type="range" id="rg" step="1"><button id="pl" aria-label="Aumentar">+</button><label class="am"><span>V$</span><input id="ra" type="text" inputmode="numeric" autocomplete="off" aria-label="Quanto colocar"></label></div>
<div class="ab2"><button id="fd">Correr</button><button id="cc">Mesa</button><button id="rs">Apostar</button><button id="rv" aria-pressed="false">Rever cartas</button></div>
<div id="pre"><button id="pf" aria-pressed="false"></button><button id="pk" aria-pressed="false"></button></div>
</div>
</div>
<div id="md"><div id="mdc"></div></div>
<div id="mnu"><div class="mc"><h2>Pausa</h2><button id="cm">Continuar jogando</button><button id="bOp">Opções</button><button id="bRl">Como jogar / Regras</button><button id="bNw">Sair para o menu principal</button></div></div>
<div id="home" class="on">
<div class="pg" id="pgH">
<div class="tb"><div class="pf"><span class="pa" id="hEm">😎</span><span id="hNm">Você</span></div><div class="ib"><button class="ic" id="hOpt" aria-label="Opções"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24"><circle cx="12" cy="12" r="3"/><path d="M19.4 15a1.65 1.65 0 0 0 .33 1.82l.06.06a2 2 0 0 1 0 2.83 2 2 0 0 1-2.83 0l-.06-.06a1.65 1.65 0 0 0-1.82-.33 1.65 1.65 0 0 0-1 1.51V21a2 2 0 0 1-2 2 2 2 0 0 1-2-2v-.09A1.65 1.65 0 0 0 9 19.4a1.65 1.65 0 0 0-1.82.33l-.06.06a2 2 0 0 1-2.83 0 2 2 0 0 1 0-2.83l.06-.06a1.65 1.65 0 0 0 .33-1.82 1.65 1.65 0 0 0-1.51-1H3a2 2 0 0 1-2-2 2 2 0 0 1 2-2h.09A1.65 1.65 0 0 0 4.6 9a1.65 1.65 0 0 0-.33-1.82l-.06-.06a2 2 0 0 1 0-2.83 2 2 0 0 1 2.83 0l.06.06a1.65 1.65 0 0 0 1.82.33H9a1.65 1.65 0 0 0 1-1.51V3a2 2 0 0 1 2-2 2 2 0 0 1 2 2v.09a1.65 1.65 0 0 0 1 1.51 1.65 1.65 0 0 0 1.82-.33l.06-.06a2 2 0 0 1 2.83 0 2 2 0 0 1 0 2.83l-.06.06a1.65 1.65 0 0 0-.33 1.82V9a1.65 1.65 0 0 0 1.51 1H21a2 2 0 0 1 2 2 2 2 0 0 1-2 2h-.09a1.65 1.65 0 0 0-1.51 1z"/></svg></button><button class="ic q" id="hRul" aria-label="Como jogar">?</button></div></div>
<div class="mid"><img class="logo" alt="Texas Hold’em" src="data:image/webp;base64,"><h1 class="sr">Texas Hold’em</h1>
<button class="mode off" id="hOn"><span class="mi"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24"><circle cx="12" cy="12" r="10"/><path d="M2 12h20M12 2a15.3 15.3 0 0 1 4 10 15.3 15.3 0 0 1-4 10 15.3 15.3 0 0 1-4-10 15.3 15.3 0 0 1 4-10z"/></svg></span><span class="mt"><b>Salas online</b><small>Jogue com outras pessoas</small></span></button>
<button class="mode go" id="hPlay"><span class="mi"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24"><rect x="4" y="8" width="16" height="12" rx="4"/><path d="M12 8V4M9.5 4h5M2 13v3M22 13v3"/><circle cx="9" cy="14" r="1.3" fill="currentColor"/><circle cx="15" cy="14" r="1.3" fill="currentColor"/></svg></span><span class="mt"><b>Salas offline</b><small>Mesas contra bots</small></span><svg class="ch" viewBox="0 0 24 24"><path d="M9 5l7 7-7 7"/></svg></button>
</div>
<p class="ver">Versão 1.0 · por <a href="https://github.com/lucasravelli" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" style="color:inherit;text-decoration:underline">Lucas Ravelli</a></p></div>
<div class="pg full" id="pgL"><div class="ph"><button class="ic bk" aria-label="Voltar"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24"><path d="M15 5l-7 7 7 7"/></svg></button><h2>Salas offline</h2></div><div class="lst" id="tbls"></div></div>
<div class="pg full" id="pgA"><div class="ph"><button class="ic bk" aria-label="Voltar"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24"><path d="M15 5l-7 7 7 7"/></svg></button><h2>Entrar</h2></div>
<div class="lst">
<div class="grp"><h4>Já tenho conta</h4><div class="gc mpc">
<input id="aMail" class="mpin" type="email" placeholder="E-mail" autocomplete="email" autocapitalize="off">
<input id="aPass" class="mpin" type="password" placeholder="Senha" autocomplete="current-password">
<button class="mpb y" id="aIn">Entrar</button></div></div>
<div class="grp"><h4>Criar conta (ganha moedas!)</h4><div class="gc mpc">
<input id="aName" class="mpin" maxlength="14" placeholder="Seu apelido" autocomplete="nickname">
<div class="emo" id="aEmo"></div>
<button class="mpb g" id="aUp">Criar conta com o e-mail e a senha acima</button>
<button class="mpb" id="aGuest">Jogar como convidado</button></div></div>
<p class="mpn" id="aMsg"></p>
</div></div>
<div class="pg full" id="pgR"><div class="ph"><button class="ic bk" aria-label="Voltar"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24"><path d="M15 5l-7 7 7 7"/></svg></button><h2>Salas online</h2></div>
<div class="lst">
<div class="grp"><div class="gc wal"><span class="em" id="wEm">🙂</span><div><div class="nm" id="wNm">Jogador</div><div class="co">🪙 <span id="wCoins">0</span> moedas</div></div><button class="mpb y" id="wDaily">Bônus diário</button></div></div>
<div class="grp" id="rRes" hidden><h4>Sua mesa</h4><button class="mpb g" id="rResB">Voltar para a mesa</button></div>
<div class="grp"><button class="mpb" id="wEdit">✏️ Editar perfil (ícone, cor, foto)</button></div>
<div class="grp"><h4>Jogar</h4><div class="gc mpc"><button class="mpb y" id="rNew">Criar sala</button>
<div style="display:flex;gap:8px"><input id="rCode" class="mpin" maxlength="5" placeholder="Código da sala" autocapitalize="characters" style="text-transform:uppercase"><button class="mpb g" id="rJoin">Entrar</button></div></div></div>
<div class="grp"><button class="mpb" id="rRank">🏆 Ranking de moedas</button></div>
<div class="grp"><h4>Salas abertas</h4><div id="rList" style="display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:12px"></div></div>
<div style="display:flex;gap:10px"><button class="mpb" id="rRef" style="flex:1">Atualizar</button><button class="mpb" id="aOut" style="flex:1">Sair da conta</button></div>
</div></div>
<div class="pg full" id="pgW"><div class="ph"><button class="ic" id="wBack" aria-label="Sair da sala"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24"><path d="M15 5l-7 7 7 7"/></svg></button><h2>Sala de espera</h2></div>
<div class="lst">
<div class="grp"><h4>Código da sala</h4><div class="gc"><div id="wCode">-----</div><div class="mpq"><span id="wInfo"></span></div></div></div>
<div class="grp"><h4>Jogadores</h4><div class="gc" id="wSeats"></div></div>
<button class="mpb y" id="wStart" hidden>Começar partida</button>
<p class="mpn" id="wHint"></p>
<button class="mpb" id="wLeave">Sair da sala (recebe as moedas de volta)</button>
</div></div>
<div class="pg full" id="pgP"><div class="ph"><button class="ic" id="pBack" aria-label="Voltar"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24"><path d="M15 5l-7 7 7 7"/></svg></button><h2>Meu perfil</h2></div>
<div class="lst">
<div class="grp"><div class="gc mpc" style="align-items:center"><div class="avbig" id="pPrev"></div>
<div style="display:flex;gap:8px;width:100%"><button class="mpb g" id="pPhoto" style="flex:1">📷 Foto</button><button class="mpb" id="pNoPhoto" style="flex:1">Tirar foto</button></div>
<input type="file" id="pFile" accept="image/*" hidden></div></div>
<div class="grp"><h4>Apelido</h4><div class="gc mpc"><input id="pName" class="mpin" maxlength="14"></div></div>
<div class="grp"><h4>Ícone</h4><div class="gc mpc"><div class="emo" id="pEmo"></div></div></div>
<div class="grp"><h4>Cor de fundo</h4><div class="gc mpc"><div class="emo" id="pCol"></div></div></div>
<button class="mpb y" id="pSave">Salvar perfil</button>
</div></div>
<div class="pg full" id="pgK"><div class="ph"><button class="ic" id="kBack" aria-label="Voltar"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24"><path d="M15 5l-7 7 7 7"/></svg></button><h2>Ranking de moedas</h2></div>
<div class="lst"><div class="grp"><div class="gc" id="kList"></div></div><p class="mpn">Conta as moedas da carteira + as fichas em mesas abertas.</p></div></div>
<div class="pg full" id="pgO"><div class="ph"><button class="ic bk" aria-label="Voltar"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24"><path d="M15 5l-7 7 7 7"/></svg></button><h2>Opções</h2></div>
<div class="lst">
<div class="grp"><h4>Áudio</h4><div class="gc">
<div class="row"><label>Som</label><div class="seg" data-k="sn"><button class="on" data-v="1">Ligado</button><button data-v="0">Desligado</button></div></div>
<div class="row"><label for="vl">Volume</label><input type="range" id="vl" min="0" max="100" value="80"></div></div></div>
<div class="grp"><h4>Jogo</h4><div class="gc">
<div class="row"><label>Velocidade</label><div class="seg" data-k="sp"><button class="on" data-v="1">Normal</button><button data-v="0.5">Rápida</button></div></div></div></div>
<div class="grp"><h4>Aparência</h4><div class="gc">
<div class="row"><label>Feltro</label><div class="seg sw" data-k="ft"><button class="on" data-v="0" aria-label="Menta" style="--g:linear-gradient(135deg,#22D18B,#0E9F68)"></button><button data-v="1" aria-label="Oceano" style="--g:linear-gradient(135deg,#35B8F5,#1C7FD0)"></button><button data-v="2" aria-label="Uva" style="--g:linear-gradient(135deg,#C77DFF,#8A3FD8)"></button></div></div>
<div class="row"><label>Cor do baralho</label><div class="seg sw" data-k="dk"><button class="on" data-v="0" aria-label="Vermelho" style="--g:#E8182D"></button><button data-v="1" aria-label="Azul" style="--g:#2F6FE8"></button></div></div></div></div>
</div></div>
<div id="sheet" hidden><div class="shp" role="dialog" aria-modal="true" aria-labelledby="shT">
<div class="shh"><div><h3 id="shT"></h3><p id="shS"></p></div><button class="ic" id="shX" aria-label="Fechar"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24"><path d="M6 6l12 12M18 6L6 18"/></svg></button></div>
<div class="fld"><label>Nível dos bots</label><div class="seg" data-k="df"><button data-v="0">Fácil</button><button class="on" data-v="1">Normal</button><button data-v="2">Difícil</button></div></div>
<div class="fld"><label>Blinds (small / big)</label><div class="seg" data-k="bl"><button class="on" data-v="10,20">10/20</button><button data-v="25,50">25/50</button><button data-v="50,100">50/100</button><button data-v="100,200">100/200</button></div></div>
<div class="fld"><label>Fichas iniciais</label><div class="seg" data-k="stack"><button data-v="500">500</button><button class="on" data-v="1000">1.000</button><button data-v="2000">2.000</button><button data-v="5000">5.000</button></div></div>
<button class="big" id="sGo">Entrar na mesa</button>
</div></div>
</div>
<div id="sheetM" hidden><div class="shp" id="mP" role="dialog" aria-modal="true"></div></div>
<div id="toast" role="status" aria-live="polite"></div>
<script>
(()=>{
'use strict';
/* ==================================================================
   CONFIGURAÇÃO DO SUPABASE  ←  PREENCHA ESTAS DUAS LINHAS
   Project Settings → API:  "Project URL"  e  chave "anon public".
   (As duas são públicas por design; a segurança vem do RLS do banco.)
   ================================================================== */
const SUPABASE_URL='COLE_AQUI_A_PROJECT_URL';       // ex.: 'https://abcdefghij.supabase.co'
const SUPABASE_ANON_KEY='COLE_AQUI_A_ANON_KEY';     // ex.: 'eyJhbGciOi...'
/* sem zoom: pinça (iOS/Safari), ctrl+scroll e atalhos de zoom no desktop */
['gesturestart','gesturechange','gestureend'].forEach(t=>document.addEventListener(t,e=>e.preventDefault(),{passive:false}));
document.addEventListener('touchmove',e=>{if(e.touches.length>1)e.preventDefault()},{passive:false});
addEventListener('wheel',e=>{if(e.ctrlKey)e.preventDefault()},{passive:false});
addEventListener('keydown',e=>{if((e.ctrlKey||e.metaKey)&&['+','=','-','_','0'].includes(e.key))e.preventDefault()});
/* ========== MOTOR: baralho, avaliador, potes ========== */
const SU=['s','h','d','c'],SY={s:'♠',h:'♥',d:'♦',c:'♣'},RK='  23456789TJQKA';let SB=10,BB=20,N=4;
const SG={14:'Ás',13:'Rei',12:'Dama',11:'Valete',10:'Dez',9:'Nove',8:'Oito',7:'Sete',6:'Seis',5:'Cinco',4:'Quatro',3:'Três',2:'Dois'};
const PL={14:'Ases',13:'Reis',12:'Damas',11:'Valetes',10:'Dez',9:'Noves',8:'Oitos',7:'Setes',6:'Seis',5:'Cincos',4:'Quatros',3:'Três',2:'Dois'};
const mkDeck=()=>{const d=[];for(const s of SU)for(let r=2;r<=14;r++)d.push({r,s});return d};
function shuffle(a){for(let i=a.length-1;i>0;i--){const j=Math.floor(Math.random()*(i+1));[a[i],a[j]]=[a[j],a[i]]}return a} // Fisher-Yates
const cmp=(a,b)=>{for(let i=0;i<Math.max(a.length,b.length);i++){const d=(a[i]||0)-(b[i]||0);if(d)return d}return 0};
function eval5(c){ // [categoria, desempates...]
const r=c.map(x=>x.r).sort((a,b)=>b-a),fl=c.every(x=>x.s===c[0].s);let st=0;
if(new Set(r).size===5){if(r[0]-r[4]===4)st=r[0];else if(r[0]===14&&r[1]===5)st=5}
const m={};r.forEach(x=>m[x]=(m[x]||0)+1);
const g=Object.entries(m).map(([k,v])=>[+k,v]).sort((a,b)=>b[1]-a[1]||b[0]-a[0]),k=g.map(x=>x[0]);
if(st&&fl)return[st===14?9:8,st];if(g[0][1]===4)return[7,...k];if(g[0][1]===3&&g[1]&&g[1][1]===2)return[6,...k];
if(fl)return[5,...r];if(st)return[4,st];if(g[0][1]===3)return[3,...k];
if(g[0][1]===2&&g[1][1]===2)return[2,...k];if(g[0][1]===2)return[1,...k];return[0,...r]}
function best7(c){let b=null;const n=c.length;(function f(s,a){if(a.length===5){const sc=eval5(a);if(!b||cmp(sc,b.sc)>0)b={sc,c:a.slice()};return}for(let i=s;i<n;i++){a.push(c[i]);f(i+1,a);a.pop()}})(0,[]);return b}
function desc(s){const c=s[0];return[`Carta Alta: ${SG[s[1]]}`,`Par de ${PL[s[1]]}`,`Dois Pares: ${PL[s[1]]} e ${PL[s[2]]}`,`Trinca de ${PL[s[1]]}`,`Sequência até ${SG[s[1]]}`,`Flush até ${SG[s[1]]}`,`Full House: ${PL[s[1]]} e ${PL[s[2]]}`,`Quadra de ${PL[s[1]]}`,`Straight Flush até ${SG[s[1]]}`,'Royal Flush'][c]}
function label(h,b){if(h.length<2)return'';const a=h.concat(b);if(a.length<5){if(h[0].r===h[1].r)return`Par de ${PL[h[0].r]}`;const[x,y]=h.slice().sort((p,q)=>q.r-p.r);return`${SG[x.r]}-${SG[y.r]}${x.s===y.s?' do mesmo naipe':''}`}return desc(best7(a).sc)}

/* ========== ESTADO ========== */
let P=[];
const G={deck:[],board:[],pot:0,cur:0,minR:BB,dealer:-1,hl:null,show:0,turn:-1,nz:.1,live:0,auto:0,peek:0,gone:[]};
let sp=1,snd=true,gid=0;
const $=s=>document.querySelector(s),fmt=n=>Math.round(n).toLocaleString('pt-BR'),sleep=async ms=>{const g=gid;await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,ms*sp));if(g!==gid)throw 0};
const alive=()=>P.filter(p=>!p.fold);
const opt=p=>!!(G.board.length===0&&G.bb===p.i&&!p.acted&&G.cur===p.bet); // opção do BB: pré-flop, ninguém aumentou e a vez chegou nele
let pa=null,paTo=0; // pré-ação do herói: 'f' (correr) | 'c' (cobrir/mesa) e quanto faltava pagar ao marcar

function commit(p,x){x=Math.min(x,p.stack);p.stack-=x;p.bet+=x;p.tot+=x;G.pot+=x;if(!p.stack)p.allin=1;sfx('chip')}
function pots(){ // pote principal + laterais
const lv=[...new Set(P.filter(p=>p.tot>0).map(p=>p.tot))].sort((a,b)=>a-b);let prev=0;const res=[];
for(const L of lv){const el=P.filter(p=>p.tot>=L),amt=(L-prev)*el.length,elig=el.filter(p=>!p.fold);prev=L;
if(!elig.length){if(res.length)res[res.length-1].amt+=amt;continue}
const key=elig.map(p=>p.i).join();if(res.length&&res[res.length-1].key===key)res[res.length-1].amt+=amt;else res.push({amt,elig,key})}
return res}

/* ========== IA DOS BOTS ========== */
function pre(h){const[a,b]=h.map(c=>c.r).sort((x,y)=>y-x);let s=a===14?10:a===13?8:a===12?7:a===11?6:a/2;
if(a===b)s=Math.max(5,s*2);if(h[0].s===h[1].s)s+=2;const g=a-b-1;
if(a!==b){s-=g<=0?0:g===1?1:g===2?2:g===3?4:5;if(g<=1&&a<12)s+=1}return Math.max(0,Math.min(1,(s+1)/20))}
function post(p){const a=p.h.concat(G.board),b=best7(a),c=b.sc[0];let s=[.12,.45,.72,.8,.86,.88,.94,.98,.99,1][c];
if(c===0)s=.12+b.sc[1]/100;
if(c===1)s=!p.h.some(x=>x.r===b.sc[1])?.2:b.sc[1]>=11?.56:.42;
if(G.board.length<5){const n={};a.forEach(x=>n[x.s]=(n[x.s]||0)+1);if(Object.values(n).includes(4)&&c<5)s+=.14}
return Math.min(1,s)}
function ai(p){const to=G.cur-p.bet,pot=G.pot,th={tag:{f:.42,r:.66,g:.55},lp:{f:.3,r:.84,g:.2},bal:{f:.38,r:.72,g:.4}}[p.style];
const s=(G.board.length?post(p):pre(p.h))+[.04,-.02,-.01,.03,.02,.01][(p.i-G.dealer+N)%N]+(Math.random()-.5)*G.nz;
const odds=to/(pot+to||1),maxT=p.bet+p.stack;
const rz=()=>({t:'r',to:Math.min(maxT,Math.max(G.cur+G.minR,G.cur+Math.round(pot*(.5+Math.random()*.5)/10)*10))});
if(!to)return s>th.r&&Math.random()<th.g+.3?rz():(Math.random()<.06&&th.g>.3?rz():{t:'c'});
if(to>=p.stack*.6&&s<.7)return{t:'f'};
if(s>th.r&&Math.random()<th.g+.2)return rz();
if(s>=th.f-(to<=BB?.1:0)||s>odds+.25)return{t:'c'};
return{t:'f'}}

/* ========== SOM (Web Audio) ========== */
let ac;function sfx(t){if(!snd)return;try{if(!ac){ac=new(window.AudioContext||window.webkitAudioContext)();ac.master=ac.createGain();ac.master.connect(ac.destination)}ac.master.gain.value=vol;if(ac.state==='suspended')ac.resume();const n=ac.currentTime;
if(t==='card'){const b=ac.createBuffer(1,ac.sampleRate*.07,ac.sampleRate),d=b.getChannelData(0);for(let i=0;i<d.length;i++)d[i]=(Math.random()*2-1)*(1-i/d.length);
const s=ac.createBufferSource(),f=ac.createBiquadFilter(),g=ac.createGain();s.buffer=b;f.type='bandpass';f.frequency.value=2200;g.gain.value=.12;s.connect(f);f.connect(g);g.connect(ac.master);s.start(n)}
else if(t==='knock')[0,.14].forEach(o=>{const os=ac.createOscillator(),g=ac.createGain(),b=ac.createBuffer(1,ac.sampleRate*.03,ac.sampleRate),d=b.getChannelData(0),ns=ac.createBufferSource(),f=ac.createBiquadFilter(),g2=ac.createGain();
os.type='sine';os.frequency.setValueAtTime(200,n+o);os.frequency.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(65,n+o+.08);g.gain.setValueAtTime(.7,n+o);g.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(.001,n+o+.13);os.connect(g);g.connect(ac.master);os.start(n+o);os.stop(n+o+.14);
for(let i=0;i<d.length;i++)d[i]=(Math.random()*2-1)*(1-i/d.length);ns.buffer=b;f.type='bandpass';f.frequency.value=1100;g2.gain.value=.25;ns.connect(f);f.connect(g2);g2.connect(ac.master);ns.start(n+o)})
else[0,.05].forEach((o,i)=>{const os=ac.createOscillator(),g=ac.createGain();os.type='triangle';os.frequency.value=i?900:1250;g.gain.setValueAtTime(.1,n+o);g.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(.001,n+o+.08);os.connect(g);g.connect(ac.master);os.start(n+o);os.stop(n+o+.09)})}catch(e){}}

/* ========== INTERFACE ========== */
const LOGO='<svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="currentColor"><path d="M12 2.5 L19.5 12.5 A4.2 4.2 0 0 1 12 15.6 A4.2 4.2 0 0 1 4.5 12.5 Z"/><path d="M12 13.5 L14.4 21.5 H9.6 Z"/></svg>';
const chipc=v=>v>=1000?'#FFD60A':v>=500?'#A855F7':v>=100?'#3B82F6':v>=25?'#22C55E':v>=5?'#F03A47':'#FFFFFF';
const POS={2:['t'],3:['l','r'],4:['l','t','r'],6:['ld','lu','t','ru','rd']};let pods=[];function build(){$('#hero').innerHTML=$('#bots').innerHTML='';pods=P.map(p=>{const e=document.createElement('div');e.className='pod'+(p.hero?' hero':'');if(!p.hero){e.dataset.pos=p.pos[0];if(p.pos[1])e.dataset.row=p.pos[1]}
e.innerHTML=`<div class="ab"></div><div class="cards"></div><div class="inf"><div class="av" style="background:${p.ac}">${p.em}<i class="pb"></i><i class="dl">D</i></div><div><div class="nm">${p.n}</div><div class="sk"></div>${p.tg?`<div class="tg">${p.tg}</div>`:''}</div></div><div class="bt"></div>`;
(p.hero?$('#hero'):$('#bots')).appendChild(e);return e});
G.gone.forEach(c=>{const e=document.createElement('div');e.className='pod gone';e.dataset.pos=c[0];if(c[1])e.dataset.row=c[1];
e.innerHTML='<div class="cards"></div><div class="inf"><div class="av"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24"><circle cx="12" cy="8.5" r="4.2"/><path d="M3.5 22c.6-5 4-7.5 8.5-7.5s7.9 2.5 8.5 7.5z"/></svg></div><div><div class="nm">Saiu</div></div></div>';$('#bots').appendChild(e)})}
function mkCard(c){const e=document.createElement('div');e.className='card';e.dataset.k=c.r+c.s;e.dataset.s=c.s;
e.innerHTML=`<div class="in"><div class="b">${LOGO}</div><div class="f"><i>${c.r===10?'10':RK[c.r]}</i><u>${SY[c.s]}</u><b>${SY[c.s]}</b></div></div>`;return e}
function setCards(div,items){const keep=new Set();
items.forEach((o,ix)=>{const k=o.c.r+o.c.s;keep.add(k);let el=div.querySelector(`[data-k="${k}"]`);
if(!el){el=mkCard(o.c);div.appendChild(el);const a=$('#deck').getBoundingClientRect(),b=el.getBoundingClientRect();
el.style.setProperty('--fx',a.left-b.left+'px');el.style.setProperty('--fy',a.top-b.top+'px');el.classList.add('new');el.style.animationDelay=(ix*.07*sp)+'s';setTimeout(()=>sfx('card'),ix*70*sp)}
el.firstChild.style.transitionDelay=(o.d||0)+'s';el.classList.toggle('up',!!o.up);el.classList.toggle('fold',!!o.fold);
el.classList.toggle('win',!!(G.hl&&G.hl.has(k)));el.classList.toggle('dim',!!(G.hl&&!G.hl.has(k)))});
[...div.children].forEach(el=>{if(!keep.has(el.dataset.k))el.remove()})}
function stk(v){let h='',k=0;for(const d of[1000,500,100,25,5,1]){let n=Math.floor(v/d);v%=d;while(n-->0&&k<5){k++;h+=`<span class="chip" style="--c:${chipc(d)}"></span>`}}return`<span class="stk">${h}</span>`}
function cnt(v){const o={};for(const d of[1000,500,100,25,5,1]){const q=Math.floor(v/d);v-=q*d;if(q)o[d]=Math.min(8,q)}return o}
function pile(v,prev){const o=cnt(v);return Object.keys(o).sort((a,b)=>b-a).map(d=>{let h='';for(let k=0;k<o[d];k++){const nw=prev&&k>=(prev[d]||0);h+=`<span class="pc${nw?' drop':''}${d==1||d==1000?' lt':''}" data-v="${d}" style="--c:${chipc(+d)};--dl:${(nw?k-(prev[d]||0):0)*70}ms"></span>`}return`<div class="pcol">${h}</div>`}).join('')}
function flyChips(a,b,n){if(!a||!b||matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce)').matches)return;const r1=a.getBoundingClientRect(),r2=b.getBoundingClientRect(),dx=r2.left+r2.width/2-r1.left-r1.width/2,dy=r2.top+r2.height/2-r1.top-r1.height/2;
for(let k=0;k<n;k++){const c=document.createElement('span');c.className='chip fly';c.style.setProperty('--c',chipc([5,25,100,5,25,1][k%6]));c.style.left=r1.left+r1.width/2-8+'px';c.style.top=r1.top+r1.height/2-8+'px';document.body.appendChild(c);
const an=c.animate([{transform:'translate(0,0) scale(.5)',opacity:0},{opacity:1,offset:.15},{transform:`translate(${dx*.5}px,${dy*.5-28}px) scale(1.25) rotate(180deg)`,offset:.55},{transform:`translate(${dx}px,${dy}px) scale(.85) rotate(360deg)`,opacity:1}],{duration:500*sp,delay:k*70*sp,easing:'cubic-bezier(.3,.7,.4,1)',fill:'both'});an.onfinish=()=>c.remove()}}
function sweep(){const t=$('#pile').getBoundingClientRect();P.forEach(p=>{const b=pods[p.i].querySelector('.bt');if(!b.firstChild)return;const r=b.getBoundingClientRect();b.style.setProperty('--tx',t.left-r.left+'px');b.style.setProperty('--ty',t.top-r.top+'px');b.classList.add('sw');sfx('chip')})}
function render(){
P.forEach(p=>{const e=pods[p.i],ab=e.querySelector('.ab');e.querySelector('.sk').textContent=fmt(p.stack);
const think=G.turn===p.i&&!p.hero,tx=think?'pensando…':p.act,ch=ab.textContent!==tx;ab.textContent=tx;ab.className='ab '+(think?'':p.cl);if(ch&&tx){void ab.offsetWidth;ab.classList.add('pp')}
e.classList.toggle('fold',!!p.fold&&!(p.hero&&G.peek));e.classList.toggle('turn',G.turn===p.i);
const bt=e.querySelector('.bt');bt.className='bt';bt.innerHTML=p.bet?`<span class="chip" style="--c:#F03A47"></span>${fmt(p.bet)}`:'';if(p.bet>(p._lb||0))flyChips(e.querySelector('.inf'),bt,Math.min(4,Math.ceil((p.bet-(p._lb||0))/BB)+1));p._lb=p.bet;
e.querySelector('.dl').style.display=G.dealer===p.i?'grid':'none';const pb=e.querySelector('.pb'),bl=G.sb===p.i?'SB':G.bb===p.i?'BB':'';pb.textContent=bl;pb.className='pb '+bl.toLowerCase();
setCards(e.querySelector('.cards'),p.h.map(c=>({c,up:p.hero?(!p.fold||!!G.peek):(G.show&&!p.fold),fold:p.fold&&!(p.hero&&G.peek),d:G.show&&!p.hero?p.i*.18*sp:0})))});
setCards($('#board'),G.board.map(c=>({c,up:1})));
const pe=$('#pot'),pt=fmt(G.pot);if(pe.textContent!==pt){pe.classList.remove('pp');void pe.offsetWidth;pe.classList.add('pp')}pe.textContent=pt;const pl=$('#pile');if(pl.dataset.v!==String(G.pot)){const inc=G.pot>+(pl.dataset.v||0);pl.innerHTML=G.pot>0?pile(G.pot,inc?(pl._pv||{}):undefined):'';pl._pv=G.pot>0?cnt(G.pot):{};pl.dataset.v=G.pot}const sp2=pots();$('#spots').textContent=sp2.length>1?sp2.slice(1).map((x,i)=>`Lateral ${i+1}: ${fmt(x.amt)}`).join(' · '):'';
$('#str').textContent=P[0].h.length?label(P[0].h,G.board):'';updPre()}
function updPre(){const bar=$('#bar'),h=P[0];
const act=!!(inGame&&G.live&&h&&!h.fold&&!h.allin&&alive().filter(p=>!p.allin).length>1),wt=act&&!opt(h)&&(G.turn!==0||!!G.auto); // na opção do BB não há pré-ação: ele precisa poder aumentar
if(wt){const to=G.cur-h.bet,call=Math.min(to,h.stack);if(pa==='c'&&to!==paTo)pa=null; // aposta mudou: seleção antiga não vale mais
$('#pf').innerHTML=`<span>${to?'Correr':'Mesa / Correr'}</span>`;
$('#pk').innerHTML=`<span>${!to?'Mesa':to>=h.stack?`All-in<small>+${fmt(call)}</small>`:`Cobrir<small>+${fmt(call)}</small>`}</span>`;
[['#pf','f'],['#pk','c']].forEach(([s,k])=>{const b=$(s);b.classList.toggle('sel',pa===k);b.setAttribute('aria-pressed',pa===k)})}
bar.classList.toggle('wt',wt&&!bar.classList.contains('on'));
const fo=!!(inGame&&h&&h.fold&&h.h.length);bar.classList.toggle('fo',fo);
if(fo){const b=$('#rv');b.textContent=G.peek?'Esconder cartas':'Rever cartas';b.classList.toggle('sel',!!G.peek);b.setAttribute('aria-pressed',!!G.peek)}}
function say(h){$('#msg').innerHTML=h;$('#mid').classList.toggle('mg',!!h)}

/* ========== FLUXO DA MÃO ========== */
async function human(p){const t0=G.cur-p.bet;
if(!opt(p)&&(pa==='f'||(pa==='c'&&t0===paTo))){const a=pa;G.auto=1;render();await sleep(450);G.auto=0;pa=null;return a==='f'&&t0>0?{t:'f'}:{t:'c'}} // chegou a vez: joga a pré-ação (correr nunca desiste de graça)
pa=null;return new Promise(res=>{
const to=G.cur-p.bet,call=Math.min(to,p.stack),maxT=p.bet+p.stack,minT=Math.min(maxT,G.cur+G.minR),can=p.stack>to&&!p.lock&&P.some(q=>q!==p&&!q.fold&&!q.allin);
const bar=$('#bar'),rz=$('#rz'),rg=$('#rg'),rs=$('#rs'),ra=$('#ra'),cc=$('#cc');
bar.classList.remove('wt');bar.classList.add('on');
cc.innerHTML=to?(to>=p.stack?`All-in<small>+${fmt(call)}</small>`:`Cobrir<small>+${fmt(call)}</small>`):'Mesa';
rs.hidden=rz.hidden=!can;rg.min=minT;rg.max=maxT;rg.value=minT;
const upd=()=>{const v=+rg.value,add=v-p.bet,all=v>=maxT;ra.value='+'+fmt(add);
rs.innerHTML=`${all?'All-in':G.cur?'Aumentar':'Apostar'}<small>+${fmt(add)}</small>`;rs.classList.toggle('allin',all)};
const set=v=>{rg.value=Math.max(minT,Math.min(maxT,Math.round(v)));upd()},num=()=>p.bet+(+String(ra.value).replace(/\D/g,'')||minT-p.bet);upd();
const fin=a=>{bar.classList.remove('on');res(a)};
$('#fd').onclick=()=>fin({t:'f'});cc.onclick=()=>fin({t:'c'});
rs.onclick=()=>{set(num());fin({t:'r',to:+rg.value})};
rg.oninput=()=>set(+rg.value);ra.onfocus=()=>ra.select();ra.onchange=()=>set(num());ra.onkeydown=e=>{if(e.key==='Enter'){set(num());ra.blur()}};
$('#mn').onclick=()=>set(+rg.value-BB);$('#pl').onclick=()=>set(+rg.value+BB)})}
async function bot(p){await sleep(600+Math.random()*500);const a=ai(p);return a.t==='r'&&(p.lock||!P.some(q=>q!==p&&!q.fold&&!q.allin))?{t:'c'}:a}
function apply(p,a){const to=G.cur-p.bet,before=G.cur;
if(a.t==='f'){p.fold=1;p.act='Correu';p.cl='f'}
else if(a.t==='c'||a.to<=G.cur){const x=Math.min(to,p.stack);if(x)commit(p,x);else sfx('knock');p.act=p.allin?`All-in ${fmt(p.bet)}`:to?`Cobriu ${fmt(x)}`:'Mesa';p.cl='c'}
else{const t=Math.min(a.to,p.bet+p.stack);commit(p,t-p.bet);
if(t>G.cur){if(t-G.cur>=G.minR){G.minR=t-G.cur;P.forEach(q=>{if(q!==p){q.acted=0;q.lock=0}})}else P.forEach(q=>{if(q!==p&&q.acted)q.lock=(t-q.seen)<G.minR?1:0}) /* all-in curto não reabre o aumento, mas vários curtos que somam um raise completo reabrem */;G.cur=t}
p.act=p.allin?`All-in ${fmt(p.bet)}`:`${before?'Aumentou':'Apostou'} ${fmt(t)}`;p.cl='r'}
p.acted=1;p.seen=G.cur}
async function round(st){let i=st;
for(let g=0;g<300;g++){const al=alive();if(al.length<2)return;
if(!al.some(p=>!p.allin&&(!p.acted||p.bet<G.cur)))return;
const na=al.filter(p=>!p.allin);if(na.length===1&&na[0].bet>=G.cur)return;
const p=P[i];i=(i+1)%N;if(p.fold||p.allin||(p.acted&&p.bet>=G.cur))continue;
G.turn=p.i;render();const a=p.hero?await human(p):await bot(p);G.turn=-1;apply(p,a);render();await sleep(250)}}
const collect=()=>{pa=null;P.forEach(p=>{p.bet=0;p.acted=0;p.lock=0;p.seen=0});G.cur=0;G.minR=BB};
function settle(){let lines=[];
{const o=P.filter(p=>p.tot>0).sort((a,b)=>b.tot-a.tot);if(o.length&&o[0].tot>(o[1]?o[1].tot:0)){const p=o[0],x=p.tot-(o[1]?o[1].tot:0);p.stack+=x;p.tot-=x;G.pot-=x;lines.push(`↩️ <b>${p.n}</b> recebe de volta ${fmt(x)} (aposta não coberta)`)}} // aposta que ninguém pôde pagar volta ao dono
const live=alive(),ps=pots(),win={},cw={};let split=0;
if(live.length===1){live[0].stack+=G.pot;win[live[0].i]=G.pot;flyChips($('#pile'),pods[live[0].i].querySelector('.inf'),6);lines.push(`<b>${live[0].n}</b> leva ${fmt(G.pot)} sem showdown`)}
else{G.show=1;live.forEach(p=>p.ev=best7(p.h.concat(G.board)));
ps.forEach(pt=>{let b=null;pt.elig.forEach(p=>{if(!b||cmp(p.ev.sc,b.ev.sc)>0)b=p});
const ws=pt.elig.filter(p=>!cmp(p.ev.sc,b.ev.sc)).sort((x,y)=>((x.i-G.dealer+N-1)%N)-((y.i-G.dealer+N-1)%N)),sh=Math.floor(pt.amt/ws.length);let rem=pt.amt-sh*ws.length;
if(ws.length>1)split=1;ws.forEach(w=>{const x=sh+(rem-->0?1:0);w.stack+=x;win[w.i]=(win[w.i]||0)+x;if(pt.elig.length>1)cw[w.i]=1});
});
const hl=new Set();P.forEach(p=>{if(win[p.i]){flyChips($('#pile'),pods[p.i].querySelector('.inf'),6);if(cw[p.i]){p.ev.c.forEach(c=>hl.add(c.r+c.s));lines.push(`🎉 <b>${p.n}</b> ganha ${fmt(win[p.i])} com ${desc(p.ev.sc)}`)}else lines.push(`🎉 <b>${p.n}</b> ganha ${fmt(win[p.i])} (pote sem disputa)`)}});G.hl=hl;
if(split||ps.length>1)lines.push(split&&ps.length>1?'Pote dividido e com laterais':split?'Pote dividido':'Com potes laterais')}
P.forEach(p=>{if(!p.stack)lines.push(p.hero?'😢 <b>Você</b> ficou sem fichas':`<b>${p.n}</b> ficou sem fichas e saiu da mesa`)});
if(P[0].stack&&P.filter(p=>p.stack).length<2)lines.push('🏆 <b>Você</b> venceu a mesa!');
G.pot=0;P.forEach(p=>p.tot=0);say(lines.join('<br>'))}
function nextBtn(){return new Promise(r=>{const over=!P[0].stack||P.filter(p=>p.stack).length<2,b=document.createElement('button');b.id='nx';b.textContent=over?'Voltar ao menu':'Próxima mão';$('#msg').appendChild(b);b.onclick=()=>over?$('#bNw').click():r()})}
async function hand(){
if(P.some(p=>!p.stack)){const old=P.slice();let k=G.dealer; // bots sem fichas saem da mesa; os assentos dos outros não mudam
old.forEach(p=>{if(!p.stack)G.gone.push(p.pos)});P=P.filter(p=>p.stack>0);P.forEach((p,i)=>p.i=i);N=P.length;
if(k>=0){while(!old[k].stack)k=(k-1+old.length)%old.length;G.dealer=P.indexOf(old[k])}
build()}
G.board=[];G.pot=0;G.cur=0;G.minR=BB;G.hl=null;G.show=0;pa=null;G.live=0;G.auto=0;G.peek=0;say('');
P.forEach(p=>{Object.assign(p,{h:[],bet:0,tot:0,fold:0,allin:0,acted:0,lock:0,seen:0,act:'',cl:''})});
document.querySelectorAll('.cards,#board').forEach(d=>d.innerHTML='');
G.dealer=(G.dealer+1)%N;const hu=N===2,sb=hu?G.dealer:(G.dealer+1)%N,bb=hu?(G.dealer+1)%N:(G.dealer+2)%N;G.sb=sb;G.bb=bb;
G.deck=shuffle(mkDeck());render();await sleep(300);
commit(P[sb],SB);P[sb].act='';commit(P[bb],BB);P[bb].act='';G.cur=BB;render();await sleep(300);
for(let r=0;r<2;r++)for(let k=0;k<N;k++){P[(sb+k)%N].h.push(G.deck.pop());render();await sleep(110)} // pop() = sem reposição
G.live=1;await round((bb+1)%N);
for(const n of[3,1,1]){if(alive().length<2)break;sweep();await sleep(330);collect();render();G.deck.pop(); // carta queimada
for(let i=0;i<n;i++){G.board.push(G.deck.pop());render();await sleep(150)}
await sleep(300);if(alive().filter(p=>!p.allin).length>1)await round((G.dealer+1)%N)}
G.live=0;sweep();await sleep(330);collect();render();await sleep(400);settle();render();await nextBtn()}
async function loop(){try{for(;;)await hand()}catch(e){if(e!==0)console.error(e)}}
