let vol=.8;const root=document.documentElement;
function setSp(v){sp=v;root.style.setProperty('--sp',sp)}
function setFelt(i){fi=i;root.style.setProperty('--felt',FT[i][0]);root.style.setProperty('--felt2',FT[i][1])}


const FT=[['#22D18B','#0E9F68'],['#35B8F5','#1C7FD0'],['#C77DFF','#8A3FD8']];let fi=0;

const HANDS=[['Royal Flush','A K Q J 10 do mesmo naipe','As Ks Qs Js Ts'],['Straight Flush','Cinco em sequência, mesmo naipe','9h 8h 7h 6h 5h'],['Quadra','Quatro cartas iguais','Qs Qh Qd Qc 4h'],['Full House','Trinca + par','Ks Kh Kd 9c 9s'],['Flush','Cinco do mesmo naipe','As 9s 7s 4s 2s'],['Sequência','Cinco em sequência (A-2-3-4-5 vale)','9c 8d 7h 6s 5c'],['Trinca','Três cartas iguais','7s 7h 7d Kc 2h'],['Dois Pares','Dois pares diferentes','Js Jh 4d 4c Ah'],['Um Par','Duas cartas iguais','Ts Th Ad 7c 3h'],['Carta Alta','Nenhuma combinação','As Jd 8c 5h 2s']];
$('#bRl').onclick=()=>{const m=$('#mdc');
m.innerHTML=`<h2>Como jogar Texas Hold’em</h2><ol>
<li><b>Blinds:</b> dois jogadores à esquerda do dealer (D) apostam o Small Blind (${fmt(SB)}) e o Big Blind (${fmt(BB)}) antes de ver as cartas.</li>
<li><b>Cartas fechadas:</b> cada um recebe 2 cartas só suas. Primeira rodada de apostas.</li>
<li><b>Flop:</b> 3 cartas comunitárias viram na mesa. Segunda rodada.</li>
<li><b>Turn:</b> a 4ª carta comunitária. Terceira rodada.</li>
<li><b>River:</b> a 5ª e última. Última rodada.</li>
<li><b>Showdown:</b> vence a melhor combinação de 5 cartas entre suas 2 e as 5 da mesa. Empate divide o pote.</li>
<li><b>Ações:</b> Correr sai da mão; Mesa segue sem apostar; Cobrir iguala a aposta; Apostar/Aumentar sobe o valor; All-in aposta todas as fichas.</li>
<li><b>Opção do Big Blind:</b> no pré-flop, se todos só pagarem o Big Blind, ele ainda tem a vez e pode dar Mesa ou Aumentar.</li></ol>
<h3>Mãos, da mais forte à mais fraca</h3><div id="hl"></div>
<div style="display:flex;gap:8px;margin-top:14px"><button id="cl" style="margin-left:auto">Fechar</button></div>`;
const hl=$('#hl');HANDS.forEach(([n,d,cs])=>{const r=document.createElement('div');r.className='hr';const c=document.createElement('div');c.className='cs';
cs.split(' ').forEach(x=>{const e=mkCard({r:x[0]==='1'?10:RK.indexOf(x[0]),s:x[x.length-1]});if(x[0]==='T')e.dataset.k='x';e.classList.add('mini');e.querySelector('.in').style.transform='rotateY(180deg)';c.appendChild(e)});
r.appendChild(c);r.insertAdjacentHTML('beforeend',`<span><b>${n}</b>${d}</span>`);hl.appendChild(r)});
$('#cl').onclick=()=>$('#md').classList.remove('on');
$('#md').classList.add('on')};
$('#md').onclick=e=>{if(e.target.id==='md')e.target.classList.remove('on')};
document.addEventListener('keydown',e=>{if(e.key==='Escape')$('#md').classList.remove('on')});
$('#rv').onclick=()=>{G.peek=G.peek?0:1;render()};
$('#pf').onclick=()=>{pa=pa==='f'?null:'f';updPre()};
$('#pk').onclick=()=>{pa=pa==='c'?null:'c';paTo=G.cur-P[0].bet;updPre()};
$('#bMn').onclick=()=>$('#mnu').classList.add('on');$('#mnu').onclick=e=>{if(['mnu','cm'].includes(e.target.id))e.currentTarget.classList.remove('on')};const S={n:'3',stack:'1000',bl:'10,20',df:'1'};let inGame=0;
const go=id=>{document.querySelectorAll('.pg').forEach(g=>g.hidden=g.id!==id);$('#sheet').hidden=true;$('#toast').classList.remove('on');$('#home').classList.add('on')};
$('#hPlay').onclick=()=>go('pgL');$('#hOpt').onclick=()=>go('pgO');$('#hRul').onclick=()=>$('#bRl').click();
document.querySelectorAll('.bk').forEach(b=>b.onclick=()=>inGame?$('#home').classList.remove('on'):go('pgH'));
const CF={};try{Object.assign(CF,JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('cfg')||'{}'))}catch(e){}
const saveCF=()=>{try{localStorage.setItem('cfg',JSON.stringify(CF))}catch(e){}};
function setSeg(sg,b,quiet){sg.querySelectorAll('button').forEach(x=>x.classList.toggle('on',x===b));const k=sg.dataset.k,v=b.dataset.v;
if(k==='sp')setSp(+v);else if(k==='dk')root.style.setProperty('--back',['#E8182D','#2F6FE8'][+v]);else if(k==='ft')setFelt(+v);else if(k==='sn'){snd=v==='1';if(!quiet)sfx('chip')}else S[k]=v;
CF[k]=v;if(!quiet)saveCF()}
document.querySelectorAll('.seg').forEach(sg=>sg.onclick=e=>{const b=e.target.closest('button');if(!b||b.disabled)return;setSeg(sg,b)});
$('#vl').oninput=e=>{vol=e.target.value/100;if(ac)ac.master.gain.value=vol;CF.vl=e.target.value;saveCF()};$('#vl').onchange=()=>sfx('chip');
$('#bOp').onclick=()=>{$('#mnu').classList.remove('on');go('pgO')};
$('#bNw').onclick=()=>{gid++;inGame=0;G.peek=0;G.live=0;G.auto=0;pa=null;updPre();$('#mnu').classList.remove('on');$('#bar').classList.remove('on');go('pgH')};
const BOTS=[{n:'Rafa',em:'🦊',ac:'#FF9F6B',style:'tag'},{n:'Duda',em:'🐼',ac:'#7BE0A6',style:'lp'},{n:'Beto',em:'🐸',ac:'#7FC4FF',style:'bal'},{n:'Lia',em:'🦉',ac:'#C9A6FF',style:'bal'},{n:'Caio',em:'🐯',ac:'#FFC46B',style:'tag'}];
const TB=[{nm:'Mesa clássica',n:4},{nm:'Mesa cheia',n:6}];
const SEAT={h:[30,79],t:[30,5],l:[5,42],r:[55,42],ld:[5,58],lu:[5,26],ru:[55,26],rd:[55,58]};
function miniTable(n){const dot=(c,f)=>`<circle cx="${SEAT[c][0]}" cy="${SEAT[c][1]}" r="5" fill="${f}" stroke="#1B0B3F" stroke-width="2"/>`;
return`<svg class="tp" viewBox="0 0 60 84" aria-hidden="true"><rect x="6.2" y="6.2" width="47.6" height="71.6" rx="23.8" fill="#1B0B3F"/><rect x="8" y="8" width="44" height="68" rx="22" fill="#22D18B" stroke="#FFC21A" stroke-width="3.5"/>${POS[n].map(c=>dot(c,'#8E9BFF')).join('')}${dot('h','#FFD60A')}</svg>`}
function renderLobby(){$('#tbls').innerHTML=TB.map((t,i)=>`<button class="tbc" data-i="${i}">${miniTable(t.n)}<span class="ti"><b>${t.nm}</b><small>${t.n} jogadores · ${t.n-1} bot${t.n>2?'s':''}</small><span class="bs">${BOTS.slice(0,t.n-1).map(b=>`<i style="background:${b.ac}">${b.em}</i>`).join('')}</span></span><span class="jg">Entrar</span></button>`).join('');
document.querySelectorAll('.tbc').forEach(b=>b.onclick=()=>openSheet(TB[+b.dataset.i]))}
function openSheet(t){S.n=String(t.n-1);$('#shT').textContent=t.nm;$('#shS').textContent=`Você + ${t.n-1} bot${t.n>2?'s':''} · ${t.n} lugares`;$('#sheet').hidden=false;$('#sGo').focus({preventScroll:true})}
const closeSheet=()=>{$('#sheet').hidden=true};
$('#shX').onclick=closeSheet;$('#sheet').onclick=e=>{if(e.target.id==='sheet')closeSheet()};
document.addEventListener('keydown',e=>{if(e.key==='Escape')closeSheet()});
let tt;function toast(m){const t=$('#toast');t.textContent=m;t.classList.add('on');clearTimeout(tt);tt=setTimeout(()=>t.classList.remove('on'),2600)}
$('#sGo').onclick=()=>{gid++;
[SB,BB]=S.bl.split(',').map(Number);G.nz=[.35,.1,.04][+S.df];
P=[{n:'Você',hero:1,em:'😎',ac:'#FFD60A'},...BOTS.slice(0,+S.n)].map((p,i)=>({...p,i,stack:+S.stack,h:[],bet:0,tot:0,fold:0,allin:0,acted:0,act:'',cl:''}));
N=P.length;P.forEach(p=>{if(!p.hero)p.pos=POS[N][p.i-1]});$('#app').classList.toggle('six',N>4);G.gone=[];G.dealer=-1;G.turn=-1;G.board=[];inGame=1;closeSheet();$('#home').classList.remove('on');build();say('');loop()};
/* ========== ONLINE (Supabase): login, carteira, salas e mesa multiplayer ========== */
const MP={uid:null,prof:null,coins:0,lastDaily:null,room:null,ch:null,inGame:false,pushed:-1,q:[],run:false,last:null,sig:'',pmap:{},cards:{},tk:0,skew:0,lastEvt:0,advAt:0,jit:Math.random()*1500,me:-1,timer:0,poll:0};
let sbc=null,sbP=null;
const AC=['#FFD60A','#FF9F6B','#7BE0A6','#7FC4FF','#C9A6FF','#FFC46B'],EMO=['😎','🦁','🐯','🐵','🦄','🐲','🤠','👽','🦊','🐧'];
const esc=s=>String(s==null?'':s).replace(/[&<>"']/g,c=>({'&':'&amp;','<':'&lt;','>':'&gt;','"':'&quot;',"'":'&#39;'}[c]));
const W=ms=>new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,ms*sp));
const cfgOk=()=>!/COLE_AQUI/.test(SUPABASE_URL+SUPABASE_ANON_KEY);
function loadSb(){if(sbc)return Promise.resolve(sbc);if(sbP)return sbP;
sbP=new Promise((ok,no)=>{const s=document.createElement('script');s.src='https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/@supabase/supabase-js@2.45.4/dist/umd/supabase.js';
s.onload=()=>{sbc=window.supabase.createClient(SUPABASE_URL,SUPABASE_ANON_KEY,{auth:{persistSession:true,autoRefreshToken:true}});ok(sbc)};
s.onerror=()=>{sbP=null;no(new Error('Sem conexão'))};document.head.appendChild(s)});return sbP}
const friendly=m=>/check constraint|wallets/i.test(m||'')?'Moedas insuficientes':(m||'Algo deu errado');
async function api(action,extra){const{data,error}=await sbc.functions.invoke('game',{body:{action,room_id:MP.room&&MP.room.id,...extra}});
if(error){let m=error.message;try{const j=await error.context.json();if(j&&j.error)m=j.error}catch(e){}throw new Error(m)}return data}

const okUrl=u=>/^https:\/\/[A-Za-z0-9.-]+\/storage\/v1\/object\/public\/avatars\/[0-9a-f-]{36}\/[A-Za-z0-9._-]+(\?v=\d+)?$/.test(u||'')?u:null;
const okCol=c=>/^#[0-9A-Fa-f]{6}$/.test(c||'')?c:null;
const avBg=(o,seat)=>{const u=okUrl(o.avatar_url||o.avatar),c=okCol(o.color)||AC[(seat||0)%6];return u?`background:url('${u}') center/cover no-repeat,${c}`:`background:${c}`};
const avTxt=o=>okUrl(o.avatar_url||o.avatar)?'':esc(String(o.emoji||'🙂').slice(0,8));
const paintAv=(el,o)=>{el.setAttribute('style',avBg(o));el.textContent=avTxt(o)};
/* ---------- entrada e login ---------- */
let emoSel=EMO[0];
$('#aEmo').innerHTML=EMO.map((e,i)=>`<button type="button" class="${i?'':'on'}" data-e="${e}">${e}</button>`).join('');
$('#aEmo').onclick=e=>{const b=e.target.closest('button');if(!b)return;emoSel=b.dataset.e;$('#aEmo').querySelectorAll('button').forEach(x=>x.classList.toggle('on',x===b))};
const aMsg=t=>{$('#aMsg').textContent=t||''};
async function mpInit(){
if(!cfgOk()){toast('Falta preencher a URL e a chave do Supabase no começo do index.html');return}
try{await loadSb()}catch(e){toast('Sem conexão com a internet');return}
const{data:{session}}=await sbc.auth.getSession();
if(session){MP.uid=session.user.id;go('pgR');mpHome()}else{aMsg('');go('pgA')}}
$('#hOn').onclick=mpInit;
async function afterAuth(user,isNew){MP.uid=user.id;if(isNew){await mpWallet();$('#wEdit').click()}else{go('pgR');mpHome()}}
$('#aIn').onclick=async()=>{aMsg('');const{data,error}=await sbc.auth.signInWithPassword({email:$('#aMail').value.trim(),password:$('#aPass').value});
if(error)return aMsg(/Invalid login/i.test(error.message)?'E-mail ou senha incorretos':error.message);afterAuth(data.user)};
$('#aUp').onclick=async()=>{aMsg('');const name=$('#aName').value.trim()||'Jogador';
const{data,error}=await sbc.auth.signUp({email:$('#aMail').value.trim(),password:$('#aPass').value,options:{data:{name,emoji:emoSel}}});
if(error)return aMsg(error.message);if(!data.session)return aMsg('Conta criada! Confirme o e-mail que enviamos e depois toque em Entrar.');afterAuth(data.user,true)};
$('#aGuest').onclick=async()=>{aMsg('');const name=$('#aName').value.trim()||'Convidado'+Math.floor(100+Math.random()*900);
const{data,error}=await sbc.auth.signInAnonymously({options:{data:{name,emoji:emoSel}}});
if(error)return aMsg(/anonymous/i.test(error.message)?'Login de convidado desativado neste projeto':error.message);afterAuth(data.user,true)};
$('#aOut').onclick=async()=>{await sbc.auth.signOut();MP.uid=null;$('#hNm').textContent='Você';paintAv($('#hEm'),{emoji:'😎',color:'#FFD60A'});go('pgH')};

/* ---------- carteira e salas abertas ---------- */
async function mpWallet(){const[p,w]=await Promise.all([sbc.from('profiles').select('*').eq('id',MP.uid).maybeSingle(),sbc.from('wallets').select('*').eq('user_id',MP.uid).maybeSingle()]);
MP.prof=p.data||{name:'Jogador',emoji:'🙂'};MP.coins=w.data?w.data.coins:0;MP.lastDaily=w.data&&w.data.last_daily;
$('#wNm').textContent=MP.prof.name;paintAv($('#wEm'),MP.prof);$('#wCoins').textContent=fmt(MP.coins);
$('#hNm').textContent=MP.prof.name+' · 🪙 '+fmt(MP.coins);paintAv($('#hEm'),MP.prof);dailyBtn()}
function dailyBtn(){const b=$('#wDaily');const left=MP.lastDaily?new Date(MP.lastDaily).getTime()+864e5-Date.now():0;
if(left>0){const h=Math.floor(left/36e5),m=Math.ceil(left%36e5/6e4);b.disabled=true;b.textContent=`Volta em ${h}h${String(m%60).padStart(2,'0')}`}else{b.disabled=false;b.textContent='Bônus diário'}}
$('#wDaily').onclick=async()=>{const{data,error}=await sbc.rpc('claim_daily');if(error)return toast(friendly(error.message));toast(`+${fmt(data)} moedas!`);mpWallet()};
async function mpHome(){await mpWallet();await Promise.all([mpResume(),mpRooms()])}
async function mpResume(){const{data}=await sbc.from('seats').select('room_id,cashed,rooms(*)').eq('user_id',MP.uid);
const m=(data||[]).find(s=>!s.cashed&&s.rooms&&['lobby','playing'].includes(s.rooms.status));MP.resume=m&&m.rooms;
$('#rRes').hidden=!MP.resume;$('#wEdit').disabled=!!MP.resume;$('#wEdit').textContent=MP.resume?'🔒 Perfil travado enquanto você está numa mesa':'✏️ Editar perfil (ícone, cor, foto)';if(MP.resume)$('#rResB').textContent=`Voltar para a mesa (${MP.resume.code})`}
$('#rResB').onclick=()=>{if(MP.resume)MP.resume.status==='lobby'?mpLobby(MP.resume):mpEnterGame(MP.resume)};
async function mpRooms(){const{data}=await sbc.from('rooms').select('*,seats(seat,name,emoji,avatar,color,user_id)').eq('status','lobby').gte('created_at',new Date(Date.now()-2*36e5).toISOString()).order('created_at',{ascending:false}).limit(20);
const L=data||[];MP.list=L;$('#rList').innerHTML=L.length?L.map((r,i)=>`<button class="tbc" data-i="${i}">${miniTable(r.max_seats)}<span class="ti"><b>${r.code}</b><small>${fmt(r.sb)}/${fmt(r.bb)} · buy-in ${fmt(r.buyin_min)}–${fmt(r.buyin_max)}</small><span class="bs">${r.seats.map(s=>`<i style="${avBg(s,s.seat)}">${avTxt(s)}</i>`).join('')}</span></span><span class="jg">${r.seats.length}/${r.max_seats}</span></button>`).join(''):'<p class="mpn">Nenhuma sala aberta. Crie a sua!</p>';
$('#rList').querySelectorAll('.tbc').forEach(b=>b.onclick=()=>openBuyin(MP.list[+b.dataset.i]))}
$('#rRef').onclick=()=>mpHome();
$('#rJoin').onclick=async()=>{const c=$('#rCode').value.trim().toUpperCase();if(!c)return toast('Digite o código da sala');
const{data}=await sbc.from('rooms').select('*').eq('code',c).maybeSingle();if(!data||data.status!=='lobby')return toast('Sala não encontrada ou já iniciada');openBuyin(data)};

/* ---------- perfil ---------- */
const EMO2=['😎','🦁','🐯','🐵','🦄','🐲','🤠','👽','🦊','🐧','🐼','🐸','🦉','🐙','🦖','🐱','🐶','🐰','🦋','🍀','⭐','🔥','👑','🎲'],COLS=[...AC,'#FF8FB1','#B7F0FF'];let PF=null;
function pfDraw(){const pv=$('#pPrev');if(PF.preview){pv.setAttribute('style',`background:url('${PF.preview}') center/cover no-repeat,${PF.color}`);pv.textContent=''}else paintAv(pv,PF);
$('#pEmo').innerHTML=EMO2.map(e=>`<button type="button" data-e="${e}" class="${e===PF.emoji?'on':''}">${e}</button>`).join('');
$('#pCol').innerHTML=COLS.map(c=>`<button type="button" data-c="${c}" class="cs ${c===PF.color?'on':''}" style="background:${c}"></button>`).join('')}
$('#wEdit').onclick=()=>{if(MP.resume)return toast('Saia da mesa para editar o perfil');const p=MP.prof||{};PF={emoji:p.emoji||'🙂',color:okCol(p.color)||AC[0],avatar_url:okUrl(p.avatar_url),blob:null,preview:null};$('#pName').value=p.name||'';pfDraw();go('pgP')};
$('#pEmo').onclick=e=>{const b=e.target.closest('button');if(b){PF.emoji=b.dataset.e;pfDraw()}};
$('#pCol').onclick=e=>{const b=e.target.closest('button');if(b){PF.color=b.dataset.c;pfDraw()}};
$('#pPhoto').onclick=()=>$('#pFile').click();
$('#pNoPhoto').onclick=()=>{PF.blob=null;PF.preview=null;PF.avatar_url=null;pfDraw()};
async function squareJpeg(f,n){const bm=await createImageBitmap(f,{imageOrientation:'from-image'}).catch(()=>createImageBitmap(f));const s=Math.min(bm.width,bm.height),c=document.createElement('canvas');c.width=c.height=n;
c.getContext('2d').drawImage(bm,(bm.width-s)/2,(bm.height-s)/2,s,s,0,0,n,n);return new Promise((ok,no)=>c.toBlob(b=>b?ok(b):no(new Error('img')),'image/jpeg',.82))}
$('#pFile').onchange=async e=>{const f=e.target.files[0];e.target.value='';if(!f)return;try{PF.blob=await squareJpeg(f,256);PF.preview=URL.createObjectURL(PF.blob);pfDraw()}catch(err){toast('Não consegui ler essa imagem')}};
$('#pBack').onclick=()=>{go('pgR');mpHome()};
$('#pSave').onclick=async e=>{const b=e.currentTarget;b.disabled=true;let np=null;const old=okUrl(MP.prof&&MP.prof.avatar_url),rm=u=>sbc.storage.from('avatars').remove([u.split('/avatars/')[1].split('?')[0]]).catch(()=>{});try{let url=PF.avatar_url;
if(PF.blob){np=MP.uid+'/a'+Date.now()+'.jpg';const{error}=await sbc.storage.from('avatars').upload(np,PF.blob,{contentType:'image/jpeg'});if(error)throw error;url=sbc.storage.from('avatars').getPublicUrl(np).data.publicUrl+'?v='+Date.now()}
const{error}=await sbc.from('profiles').update({name:$('#pName').value.trim().slice(0,14)||'Jogador',emoji:PF.emoji,color:PF.color,avatar_url:url}).eq('id',MP.uid);if(error)throw error;
if(old&&old!==url)rm(old);toast('Perfil salvo!');go('pgR');mpHome()}catch(err){if(np)sbc.storage.from('avatars').remove([np]).catch(()=>{});toast(friendly(err.message))}b.disabled=false};
async function mpRank(){go('pgK');$('#kList').innerHTML='<p class="mpn" style="padding:14px">Carregando…</p>';const{data,error}=await sbc.rpc('leaderboard',{_limit:20});if(error)return toast(friendly(error.message));
$('#kList').innerHTML=(data||[]).map((r,i,a)=>`${i&&r.rank-a[i-1].rank>1?'<div class="mpn">⋯</div>':''}<div class="mps${r.user_id===MP.uid?' me':''}"><small style="width:34px">${r.rank<=3?['🥇','🥈','🥉'][r.rank-1]:'#'+r.rank}</small><span class="av2" style="${avBg(r,0)}">${avTxt(r)}</span><b>${esc(r.name)}</b><small>🪙 ${fmt(r.total)}</small></div>`).join('')}
$('#rRank').onclick=mpRank;$('#kBack').onclick=()=>go('pgR');
/* ---------- sheet genérico ---------- */
const mClose=()=>{$('#sheetM').hidden=true};
function msheet(title,sub,body,label,onGo){$('#mP').innerHTML=`<div class="shh"><div><h3>${title}</h3><p>${sub}</p></div><button class="ic" id="mX" aria-label="Fechar"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24"><path d="M6 6l12 12M18 6L6 18"/></svg></button></div>${body}<button class="big" id="mGo">${label}</button>`;
$('#sheetM').hidden=false;$('#mX').onclick=mClose;$('#mGo').onclick=async e=>{const b=e.currentTarget;b.disabled=true;try{await onGo()}catch(err){toast(friendly(err.message))}b.disabled=false}}
$('#sheetM').onclick=e=>{if(e.target.id==='sheetM')mClose()};
function segHtml(id,label,opts,sel){return`<div class="fld"><label>${label}</label><div class="seg" id="${id}">${opts.map(([v,t,dis],i)=>`<button type="button" data-v="${v}" class="${i===sel?'on':''}"${dis?' disabled':''}>${t}</button>`).join('')}</div></div>`}
function segBind(id,cb){const sg=$('#'+id);sg.onclick=e=>{const b=e.target.closest('button');if(!b||b.disabled)return;sg.querySelectorAll('button').forEach(x=>x.classList.toggle('on',x===b));cb&&cb(b.dataset.v)}}
const segVal=id=>{const b=$('#'+id+' button.on');return b?b.dataset.v:null};
const buyins=r=>{const mid=Math.round((r.buyin_min+r.buyin_max)/2/r.bb)*r.bb;return[...new Set([r.buyin_min,mid,r.buyin_max])]};

/* ---------- criar sala / entrar com buy-in ---------- */
function buyinSeg(r){const o=buyins(r);const ok=o.findIndex(v=>v<=MP.coins);return segHtml('mBy','Seu buy-in (moedas → fichas)',o.map(v=>[v,fmt(v),v>MP.coins]),Math.max(0,ok))}
async function joinRoom(r){const by=+segVal('mBy');if(!by)return;const{error}=await sbc.rpc('join_room',{_code:r.code,_buyin:by});if(error)throw error;
const{data}=await sbc.from('rooms').select('*').eq('id',r.id).single();mClose();await mpWallet();mpLobby(data)}
function openBuyin(r){if(MP.coins<r.buyin_min)return toast('Moedas insuficientes — colete o bônus diário');
msheet(`Sala ${r.code}`,`Blinds ${fmt(r.sb)}/${fmt(r.bb)} · você tem 🪙 ${fmt(MP.coins)}`,buyinSeg(r),'Entrar na mesa',()=>joinRoom(r));segBind('mBy')}
$('#rNew').onclick=()=>{const PR=[[500,2500],[1000,5000],[2500,10000]];
const body=segHtml('cSe','Lugares na mesa',[[2,'2'],[4,'4'],[6,'6']],1)+segHtml('cBl','Blinds (small / big)',[['10,20','10/20'],['25,50','25/50'],['50,100','50/100'],['100,200','100/200']],0)+segHtml('cPr','Buy-in permitido',PR.map((p,i)=>[i,`${fmt(p[0])}–${fmt(p[1])}`]),0)+segHtml('cBo','Nível dos bots',[['facil','Fácil'],['normal','Normal'],['dificil','Difícil']],1)+'<div id="cBy"></div>';
const draw=()=>{const[sb,bb]=segVal('cBl').split(',').map(Number),p=PR[+segVal('cPr')];$('#cBy').innerHTML=buyinSeg({buyin_min:p[0],buyin_max:p[1],bb});segBind('mBy')};
msheet('Criar sala','Vagas vazias viram bots quando você começar',body,'Criar e entrar',async()=>{const[sb,bb]=segVal('cBl').split(',').map(Number),p=PR[+segVal('cPr')];
if(MP.coins<p[0])throw new Error('Moedas insuficientes para este buy-in');
const{data,error}=await sbc.rpc('create_room',{_max_seats:+segVal('cSe'),_sb:sb,_bb:bb,_buyin_min:p[0],_buyin_max:p[1],_bot_level:segVal('cBo')});if(error)throw error;await joinRoom(data)});
['cSe','cBl','cPr','cBo'].forEach(id=>segBind(id,id==='cBl'||id==='cPr'?draw:null));draw()};

/* ---------- sala de espera ---------- */
function mpSub(){mpUnsub();const id=MP.room.id;
MP.ch=sbc.channel('room-'+id).on('postgres_changes',{event:'*',schema:'public',table:'seats',filter:'room_id=eq.'+id},()=>{if(!MP.inGame)lobbyTick()})
.on('postgres_changes',{event:'UPDATE',schema:'public',table:'rooms',filter:'id=eq.'+id},p=>onRoom(p.new))
.on('postgres_changes',{event:'*',schema:'public',table:'room_state',filter:'room_id=eq.'+id},p=>{if(p.new&&p.new.public&&p.new.public.players)mpPush(p.new.public)}).subscribe()}
function mpUnsub(){if(MP.ch){sbc.removeChannel(MP.ch);MP.ch=null}}
function mpLobby(room){MP.room=room;MP.inGame=false;mClose();go('pgW');mpSub();lobbyTick();clearInterval(MP.poll);MP.poll=setInterval(()=>{if(!MP.inGame)lobbyTick()},3000)}
async function lobbyTick(){if(!MP.room)return;const[r,s]=await Promise.all([sbc.from('rooms').select('*').eq('id',MP.room.id).maybeSingle(),sbc.from('seats').select('*').eq('room_id',MP.room.id).order('seat')]);
if(!r.data||!MP.room)return;MP.room=r.data;if(onRoom(r.data))return;const R=r.data,L=s.data||[];
if(!L.some(x=>x.user_id===MP.uid)&&R.status==='lobby'){clearInterval(MP.poll);MP.room=null;mpUnsub();toast('Você não está mais nesta sala');go('pgR');mpHome();return}
$('#wCode').textContent=R.code;$('#wInfo').textContent=`${R.max_seats} lugares · blinds ${fmt(R.sb)}/${fmt(R.bb)} · buy-in ${fmt(R.buyin_min)}–${fmt(R.buyin_max)}`;
let h='';for(let i=0;i<R.max_seats;i++){const x=L.find(y=>y.seat===i);h+=x?`<div class="mps"><span class="av2" style="${avBg(x,i)}">${avTxt(x)}</span><b>${esc(x.name)}${x.user_id===R.host_id?' 👑':''}</b><small>🪙 ${fmt(x.stack)}</small></div>`:`<div class="mps free"><span class="av2" style="background:#EFE8FF">🤖</span><b>Vaga livre → bot</b></div>`}
$('#wSeats').innerHTML=h;const host=R.host_id===MP.uid,free=R.max_seats-L.length;$('#wStart').hidden=!host;
$('#wStart').textContent=free?`Começar agora (${free} bot${free>1?'s':''})`:'Começar partida';$('#wHint').textContent=host?'Quando começar, as vagas vazias serão preenchidas por bots.':'Aguardando o anfitrião começar…'}
function onRoom(R){if(!MP.room||!R)return false;if(R.status==='playing'&&!MP.inGame){mpEnterGame(R);return true}
if(R.status==='closed'&&!MP.inGame){clearInterval(MP.poll);MP.room=null;mpUnsub();toast('A sala foi encerrada');go('pgR');mpHome();return true}return false}
$('#wStart').onclick=async e=>{const b=e.currentTarget;b.disabled=true;try{await api('start')}catch(err){toast(err.message);b.disabled=false}};
async function leaveLobby(){clearInterval(MP.poll);try{await api('leave')}catch(e){toast(e.message)}MP.room=null;mpUnsub();go('pgR');mpHome()}
$('#wLeave').onclick=leaveLobby;$('#wBack').onclick=leaveLobby;

/* ---------- mesa multiplayer: o servidor manda o estado, a interface só desenha ---------- */
async function mpEnterGame(R){MP.room=R;MP.inGame=true;clearInterval(MP.poll);mClose();mpSub();
MP.pushed=-1;MP.q=[];MP.last=null;MP.sig='';MP.cards={};MP.tk++;gid++;inGame=1;P=[];G.gone=[];G.dealer=-1;G.turn=-1;G.board=[];G.live=0;G.show=0;G.hl=null;pa=null;
$('#hero').innerHTML=$('#bots').innerHTML='';say('');$('#home').classList.remove('on');$('#bNw').textContent='Sair da mesa';
const{data}=await sbc.from('room_state').select('public').eq('room_id',R.id).maybeSingle();if(data&&data.public&&data.public.players)mpPush(data.public);
clearInterval(MP.timer);MP.timer=setInterval(mpTick,500)}
function mpPush(s){if(!MP.inGame||s.v<=MP.pushed)return;MP.pushed=s.v;MP.lastEvt=Date.now();MP.q.push(s);if(MP.q.length>3)MP.q=MP.q.slice(-1);mpRun()}
async function mpRun(){if(MP.run)return;MP.run=true;try{while(MP.q.length){const s=MP.q.shift();try{await mpProcess(s)}catch(e){console.error(e)}}}finally{MP.run=false}}
async function myCards(hn){if(MP.cards[hn])return;for(let t=0;t<8;t++){const{data}=await sbc.from('hand_cards').select('cards').eq('room_id',MP.room.id).eq('hand_no',hn).eq('user_id',MP.uid).maybeSingle();if(data){MP.cards={[hn]:data.cards};return}await W(400)}}
const PH=[{r:2,s:'x'},{r:3,s:'x'}];
function revealOpp(p,cards){const els=[...pods[p.i].querySelector('.cards').children];cards.forEach((c,ix)=>{const el=els[ix];if(el&&el.dataset.ph){const n=mkCard(c);el.dataset.k=c.r+c.s;el.dataset.s=c.s;el.innerHTML=n.innerHTML;delete el.dataset.ph}})}
async function mpProcess(s){
const prev=MP.last,Nt=s.players.length,me=s.players.find(q=>q.uid===MP.uid);if(!me)return;MP.me=me.seat;MP.skew=s.now-Date.now();
const newHand=!prev||prev.hand_no!==s.hand_no;
if(prev&&!newHand&&P.length&&prev.players.some(q=>q.bet>0)&&s.players.every(q=>q.bet===0)){sweep();await W(330)}
if(newHand&&P.length){document.querySelectorAll('.cards,#board').forEach(d=>d.innerHTML='');say('');G.hl=null;G.peek=0;pa=null;P.forEach(p=>p._lb=0)}
if(me.nc&&newHand)await myCards(s.hand_no);
const rot=[];for(let k=0;k<Nt;k++)rot.push(s.players[(me.seat+k)%Nt]);
const useOut=s.phase==='bet',isOut=q=>useOut&&q.out&&q.seat!==me.seat;
const sig=Nt+'|'+rot.map(q=>q.seat+':'+q.name+':'+(isOut(q)?1:0)).join('|');
if(sig!==MP.sig){MP.sig=sig;P=[];G.gone=[];MP.pmap={};
rot.forEach((q,k)=>{const pos=k?POS[Nt][k-1]:null;if(k&&isOut(q)){G.gone.push(pos);return}
const p={n:esc(q.name),em:avTxt(q),ac:avBg(q,q.seat).replace(/^background:/,''),hero:k?0:1,seat:q.seat,pos,i:P.length,h:[],_lb:0};P.push(p);MP.pmap[q.seat]=p});
N=P.length;$('#app').classList.toggle('six',Nt>4);build()}
const ix=seat=>{const p=MP.pmap[seat];return p?p.i:-1};
SB=s.sb_amt;BB=s.bb_amt;
s.players.forEach(q=>{const p=MP.pmap[q.seat];if(!p)return;Object.assign(p,{stack:q.stack,bet:q.bet,tot:q.tot,fold:q.fold?1:0,allin:q.allin?1:0,acted:q.acted?1:0,lock:q.lock?1:0,act:q.act||'',cl:q.cl||''});
p.h=p.hero?(q.nc&&MP.cards[s.hand_no]?MP.cards[s.hand_no]:[]):(q.cards?q.cards:PH.slice(0,q.nc));
if(!p.hero&&q.cards)revealOpp(p,q.cards)});
Object.assign(G,{board:s.board.slice(),pot:s.pot,cur:s.cur,minR:s.minR,dealer:ix(s.dealer),sb:ix(s.sb),bb:ix(s.bb),turn:s.turn>=0?ix(s.turn):-1,live:s.phase==='bet'?1:0,show:s.show?1:0,hl:s.show&&s.hl.length?new Set(s.hl):null});
render();
document.querySelectorAll('.pod:not(.hero) .cards .card').forEach(el=>{if(!el.dataset.ph&&el.dataset.s==='x')el.dataset.ph='1'});
if(s.phase!=='bet'&&s.msg&&s.msg.length&&(!prev||prev.v!==s.v)){const lines=s.msg.slice();const pay=s.payout&&s.payout[me.seat];
if(s.over&&pay>0)lines.push(`💰 <b>Você</b> recebeu ${fmt(pay)} moedas`);
say(lines.join('<br>')+(s.over?'':'<br><small id="cdn"></small>'));
if(!prev||prev.phase==='bet'||newHand)Object.keys(s.win||{}).forEach(k=>{const i=ix(+k);if(i>=0)flyChips($('#pile'),pods[i].querySelector('.inf'),6)});
if(s.over){const b=document.createElement('button');b.id='nx';b.textContent='Voltar ao menu';$('#msg').appendChild(b);b.onclick=()=>mpExit(true)}}
MP.last=s;MP.tk++;
if(s.phase==='bet'&&s.turn===me.seat&&!me.fold&&!me.allin)mpTurn(MP.tk);else{$('#bar').classList.remove('on');updPre()}}
async function mpTurn(tk){let a;try{a=await human(P[0])}catch(e){return}if(tk!==MP.tk)return;MP.tk++;$('#bar').classList.remove('on');
try{await api('act',{a})}catch(e){if(!/vez|ocupada|pronta/i.test(e.message))toast(e.message)}}
function mpTick(){if(!MP.inGame||!MP.last)return;const s=MP.last,now=Date.now()+MP.skew,t=$('#tmr');
if(s.phase==='bet'&&s.deadline&&s.turn>=0){const l=Math.max(0,Math.ceil((s.deadline-now)/1000));t.textContent=(s.turn===MP.me?'Sua vez: ':'⏳ ')+l+'s'}else t.textContent='';
const cd=$('#cdn');if(cd&&s.next_at)cd.textContent='Próxima mão em '+Math.max(0,Math.ceil((s.next_at-now)/1000))+'s';
if(s.phase==='over'||Date.now()-MP.advAt<4000)return;
const stale=Date.now()-MP.lastEvt,pl=s.turn>=0?s.players[s.turn]:null;
const need=(s.phase==='between'&&s.next_at&&now>s.next_at+MP.jit)||(s.phase==='bet'&&pl&&!pl.bot&&s.deadline&&now>s.deadline+1200+MP.jit)||(s.phase==='bet'&&(!pl||pl.bot)&&stale>12000)||(s.phase==='bet'&&stale>45000);
if(need){MP.advAt=Date.now();api('advance').catch(()=>{});if(stale>5000)mpFetch()}}
async function mpFetch(){if(!MP.room)return;const{data}=await sbc.from('room_state').select('public').eq('room_id',MP.room.id).maybeSingle();if(data&&data.public&&data.public.players)mpPush(data.public)}
document.addEventListener('visibilitychange',()=>{if(!document.hidden&&MP.inGame)mpFetch()});
async function mpExit(done){const r=MP.room;if(!r)return;const mid=!!(MP.last&&MP.last.phase==='bet');MP.inGame=false;MP.tk++;gid++;inGame=0;clearInterval(MP.timer);clearInterval(MP.poll);mpUnsub();$('#tmr').textContent='';$('#bar').classList.remove('on');$('#bNw').textContent='Sair para o menu principal';
try{await api('leave');if(mid)toast('Você correu. As fichas voltam para a carteira ao fim da mão.')}catch(e){toast(e.message)}MP.room=null;MP.last=null;go('pgR');mpHome()}
const bNw0=$('#bNw').onclick;
$('#bNw').onclick=function(e){if(MP.inGame){const s=MP.last;if(s&&s.phase!=='over'&&s.phase!=='between'&&!confirm('Sair da mesa agora? Você corre a mão atual e recebe suas fichas de volta como moedas.'))return;$('#mnu').classList.remove('on');mpExit();return}return bNw0.call(this,e)};
document.addEventListener('keydown',e=>{if(e.key==='Escape')mClose()});
renderLobby();
Object.entries(CF).forEach(([k,v])=>{if(k==='vl'){$('#vl').value=v;vol=v/100}else{const b=document.querySelector(`.seg[data-k="${k}"] button[data-v="${v}"]`);if(b)setSeg(b.parentElement,b,true)}});
go('pgH');
})();
</script>
<script>if('serviceWorker' in navigator&&/^https?:/.test(location.protocol))addEventListener('load',()=>{try{navigator.serviceWorker.register('sw.js').catch(()=>{})}catch(e){}})</script>
</body>
</html>
